greenhouse|4000982201|.description: What the role is: As a Talent Acquisition Sourcer at GovTech Singapore, you will play a pivotal role in identifying and engaging top-tier tech talent to drive our mission of building Tech for Public Good. You will be a hands-on partner, focusing on the crucial initial stages of the recruitment lifecycle, and contributing to the transformation of how GovTech attracts and secures the best minds in the industry. This role requires a strategic approach to talent identification, balancing immediate hiring needs with the long-term development of our talent pipelines. This will initially start off as a 12-month contract. What you'll be working on: Your primary responsibilities will include: Strategic Sourcing: Design and execute innovative sourcing strategies to identify passive and active candidates for highly specialized tech roles, including but not limited to Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, Data Science, and Cloud Architecture. Talent Mapping & Market Intelligence: Conduct in-depth talent mapping exercises and gather market intelligence to understand talent landscapes, identify key organizations, and pinpoint emerging talent pools relevant to GovTech's strategic objectives. Candidate Engagement: Craft compelling outreach messages and engage potential candidates through various channels, building strong relationships and effectively communicating GovTech's value proposition and mission. Pipeline Development: Proactively build and nurture robust talent pipelines for both immediate hiring needs and future critical roles, ensuring a continuous flow of qualified candidates. Collaboration & Partnership: Work closely with Talent Acquisition Partners and hiring managers to understand specific role requirements, team dynamics, and strategic priorities, translating these into effective sourcing plans. Process Optimization: Contribute to the continuous improvement of sourcing processes, tools, and systems, leveraging data and insights to enhance efficiency, candidate experience, and overall recruitment effectiveness. Employer Branding: Act as an ambassador for GovTech, promoting our unique culture, values (Agile, Bold, Collaborative), and the impact of working on projects that serve the public good. What we are looking for: We are seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented individual with a passion for connecting talent with purpose. The ideal candidate will possess: Proven Sourcing Expertise: A solid track record in talent sourcing, preferably within the technology sector, with demonstrated success in identifying and engaging candidates for niche and hard-to-fill roles. Technical Acumen: A strong understanding of various tech domains and roles (e.g., software development, product management, design, data engineering, cybersecurity etc) to effectively identify and assess relevant talent. Strategic Mindset: Ability to think strategically about talent acquisition challenges and develop creative, data-driven sourcing solutions. Communication & Influence: Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build rapport quickly and influence potential candidates. Stakeholder Management: Experience working effectively with hiring managers and internal stakeholders, providing insights and guiding them through the sourcing process. Tool Proficiency: Proficiency in using various sourcing tools and platforms, including LinkedIn Recruiter, applicant tracking systems (ATS), and other online databases and social media channels. Data-Driven Approach: A commitment to using data and metrics to inform sourcing strategies, track performance, and report on key talent insights. Alignment with GovTech Values: A genuine interest in GovTech's mission of Tech for Public Good and an embodiment of our Agile, Bold, and Collaborative values. Project Management Skills: Ability to lead or contribute to projects aimed at enhancing recruitment efficiency and candidate experience. Join us in shaping Singapore's digital future!

At MOE, we are working to enhance Mother Tongue Language (MTL) education through the thoughtful application of AI technologies. As a Senior AI Product Manager, you will partner with the Mother Tongue Languages Branch (MTLB) to lead the design, development, and integration of AI-enhanced MTL learning solutions that support how students learn languages. You will work closely with curriculum specialists to ensure AI solutions are pedagogically sound and aligned with educational needs. At the same time, you will bring strong product management skills and technical appreciation to guide the development, piloting, evaluation, and scaling of these solutions. This role requires cross-functional collaboration, structured implementation, and data-informed decision-making — helping MOE deliver practical, scalable AI/EdTech tools that improve language learning outcomes. Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic Planning and Implementation Partner with curriculum specialists to co-develop AI/EdTech initiatives that are pedagogically grounded and learner-centric. Translate learning goals into clear product requirements while balancing feasibility, scalability, and resource considerations. Develop a standardized evaluation framework to assess initiatives across both pedagogical and technical dimensions. Establish clear processes for procurement, development, piloting, and implementation of AI enhanced learning tools. 2. Technology Partnership and Product Management Act as the key product liaison between MTLB, DXD, vendors, and other internal and external stakeholders. Coordinate with technical experts to align system architecture, AI models, integration, and compliance requirements with educational goals. Shape product direction by contributing strategic input and ensuring alignment across technical, pedagogical, and user needs. Translate product and curriculum requirements into clear technical specifications to inform procurement and vendor deliverables. 3. Project and Resource Management Oversee project execution, including milestone planning, timelines, budgeting, and risk mitigation. Manage procurement and contract administration for AI/EdTech initiatives in collaboration with MOE stakeholders. Coordinate day-to-day delivery across internal teams and vendors to ensure timely, high quality implementation of AI solutions in schools. 4. Evaluation and Scaling Support the planning, execution, and analysis of pilot initiatives. Develop robust evaluation frameworks to assess impact and guide decisions on scaling. Synthesise feedback into actionable insights that strengthen future deployments. 5. Stakeholder Engagement and Change Leadership Facilitate effective communication between curriculum teams, product and technical teams, and external partners. Present updates and recommendations to senior management. Manage expectations, align stakeholders, and lead change management efforts to support smooth adoption of new tools. Job Expectations User-Centric Focus: Design AI solutions that address educators’ needs and improve both teaching effectiveness and student learning. Strategic Thinking: Develop clear, scalable adoption strategies that align with MOE’s educational goals. Product and Technical Fluency: Demonstrate strong product leadership with an appreciation for AI/ML technologies and their practical application in education. Collaboration and Communication: Build strong partnerships across MOE and external stakeholders, and communicate clearly across technical and educational domains. Data-Informed Approach: Leverage analytics and pilot results to refine strategies and scale effective solutions. Project Management: Drive efficient, high-quality execution of multiple AI initiatives in alignment with curriculum priorities. Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Education Technology, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred. At least 5 years of experience in product management, preferably involving AI/ML solutions or EdTech platforms. Proven track record of designing, developing, and implementing digital products at scale. Experience working in cross-functional teams with designers, engineers, curriculum specialists, and external vendors. Strong understanding of AI/ML technologies and their applications in education, including ethics, compliance, and data privacy considerations. Skilled in agile methodologies, product lifecycle management, and iterative pilot-to-scale implementation. Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement, and influence skills. Passion for public good, with a strong interest in education and language learning innovation We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company as we believe that diversity is meaningful to innovation. Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. This includes generous leave benefits to meet your work-life needs. We also believe it’s important for you to keep honing your craft in the constantly-evolving tech landscape, so we provide and support a plethora of in-house and external learning and development opportunities all year round. Audit experience and knowledge relating to cyber security, network and infrastructure, cloud security and virtualisation, application security and development, data privacy and protection, and/or business continuity and disaster recovery would be a plus. Prior experience leading audits and conducting audit fieldwork and has good working knowledge and understanding of regulatory compliance, governance and internal controls. As the Senior Product Manager in GovTech, you will assist the Project Director and work with the product team to revamp the whole of government (WOG) finance and accounting system and to drive innovative digital product throughout their life cycles, so that government agencies can successfully deliver their digital agenda. Product Managers make sure that the right things get done so that our digital products meet user needs and continuously remain relevant. At a high level, this means establishing a clear vision for what a product should be and what is needed to get there. On a day-to-day basis, this means handling all the different facets of a product and making sure they are coordinated – across user needs, technical constraints, and design goals. Success in the role will be proven by your ability to thrive in a dynamic and multifaceted environment, while keeping yourself up to date on new technology developments. What you will be working on You are a hands-on Senior Product Manager and will be involved in planning and executing the full product lifecycle including the following: 1. Crafting Customer Experiences for Each User Journey • Engage the agency Product Owner to establish a clear vision for what the product should be and what is needed to get there • Collaborate with business partners to define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, as well as obtain key stakeholder buy-in • Work out the product outreach and promotion strategies with business partners • Define the product go-to-market strategy and work with relevant partners to execute the plan 2. Designing, Testing, and Iterating Through Experiments • Design, test, and iterate through experiments to improve the user journey • Execute hands-on system configuration when required, including developing proof-of-concept (POC) to validate new features • Manage the product budget through expenditure monitoring, cashflow management, and securing funding • Develop the workplan and ensure successful delivery by the product team / external vendors • Provide sufficient resources for product development, including procurement of software, hardware, and ICT professional services 3. Monitoring, Capturing, and Studying User Behaviour • Conduct user studies to understand their needs and problems • Analyse data to uncover usage patterns that can inform product decisions • Research the industry to understand complimentary and competing solutions 4. Collecting, Analyzing, and Presenting User Interest • Translate the product strategy into technical, detailed, actionable plans for business and vendor teams • Understand the developers’ needs and if necessary support them in exploring emerging tools and techniques that can meet their needs 5. Analysing and Studying User Segments • Formulate strong proposals by evaluating the pros and cons of different solutions and provide compelling justifications for them • Consider how the services could be delivered for different market segments and prioritize feature development 6. Creating Data-Driven Analytics and Insights • Create data-driven analytics and insights for action and to make appropriate trade-offs • Coordinate efforts across multiple functions including marketing, legal, and finance • Co-create with the Product Owner to draft the budget papers to seek resources for the product's development 7. Driving User Growth • Drive user adoption and growth through increased engagement, expanding types of features, and higher usage in a financially sustainable manner • Maintain a wide network with key user agencies and central government product teams to seek opportunities for product collaborations • Participate in public-speaking engagements to raise awareness of the product and gain more users 8. Keeping Things Organized • Run efficient meetings to keep stakeholders and product team members updated • Prioritize, plan, and track what needs to be done • Document key information and decisions about the product • Be responsible for securing funding and monitoring expenses 9. Compliance and Governance • Ensure that Product meets security and performance requirements (SSAT, VAPT, Performance Testing) • Adhere to compliance requirements and audits (IM, AGO, QMS, etc.) What we are looking for Degree in Computer Science or Infocomm Technology or Electronics Engineering or related discipline with a minimum 5 years of relevant ICT experience. Experienced in large scale projects involving multiple government agencies / organisational units Candidates with working experience in implementing SaaS ERP or finance and accounting systems with development budget exceeding $5m Prior working experience in product management, IT business analysis, application solutioning design and testing Experience in modern product development/management technologies and practices such as Agile, Cloud, Design Thinking, and Product-Centric Development will be strongly preferred. Working directly with engineers, designers and other product managers (ideally at least 3 years). Strong analytical, conceptualisation and problem-solving skills Good communication skills with the ability to pitch ideas and influence A driven and motivated personality with an inquisitive mind Ability to learn and apply Relevant certifications such as CITPM, COMIT, PMP, and Certified Scrum Master. greenhouse|4003191201|.description: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) is responsible for the Government Procurement (GP) policies, which govern how government agencies conduct their procurement. With evolving needs of our public officers and changing procurement landscape, MOF is embarking on the Whole of Government Procurement initiative. GeBIZ X is the MOF product that would transform the procurement and business experience for WOG public officers and external suppliers. Our team is made up of passionate individuals committed to solving challenges and driving meaningful change. We embrace diversity of thought, encourage experimentation, and foster a culture of continuous learning. As part of this team, you will lead design direction and collaborate with UX designers, finance officers, and solution providers — forward-thinking professionals equally invested in your growth and in transforming MOF’s corporate finance services. We are seeking a dynamic and strategic Lead Designer to lead our product team. This individual will play a pivotal role in shaping the vision, strategy, and execution of GeBIZ X product portfolio. The Lead Designer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive product innovation, ensure market fit, and deliver exceptional value to our customers. The Lead Designer leads strategic design initiatives while ensuring alignment with organizational goals. He/She coordinates and plans discovery research, including user interviews, workshops, surveys, usability testing, and gathering insights to understand user needs and pain points; evaluates the usability of new and existing products and makes constructive suggestions for change. Key responsibilities include translating discovery research into actionable insights, creating wireframes and prototypes in Figma, conducting user testing, iterating designs based on feedback, and collaborating closely with product manager, software engineer to deliver user-centric solutions within technical constraints. Define and Drive Procurement Design Strategy, Roadmap, and Outcomes Develop and own the design vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for end-to-end procurement systems, aligned with MOF's digitalisation priorities. Establish, track, and deliver on design OKRs and success metrics that drive user adoption, operational impact, and continuous improvement. Prioritise design initiatives that maximise value creation and usability for procurement stakeholders, from requisition through contract management and vendor relations. Enhance Procurement Operations through Human-Centred Design and Systems Thinking Strengthen procurement workflows by embedding user research and data-driven design decisions to support strategic sourcing, vendor evaluation, and contract lifecycle management. Redesign procurement interfaces and experiences through systematic design standards that enable intuitive, multi-stakeholder collaboration across complex technology solutions (eg. SaaS/ Bespoke). Implement design systems and methodologies that proactively identify user friction points and reduce operational risk through detection of usability barriers in procurement processes. Coach and Develop the Procurement Design Practice Mentor and develop designers and design researchers to build internal capabilities and foster a high-performance, user-focused design culture. Promote cross-functional collaboration between design, product, and engineering teams whilst evangelising design-led problem-solving across the finance and digital teams. Lead the development of design standards, frameworks, and measurement methodologies that demonstrate design impact beyond traditional product metrics in complex government procurement contexts. Required qualifications, skills and mindset: Bachelor’s degree in Industrial design, Interaction design, Human Computer Interaction (HCI), Visual Arts or similar; Master’s degree preferred. Minimum of 8 years of experience in design across multiple industries, with demonstrated success in launching and scaling complex digital products. Proven track record of leading end-to-end design initiatives from discovery through delivery, with measurable impact on user adoption and business outcomes. Strategic design thinking with strong analytical and synthetic capabilities, including the ability to navigate ambiguity and drive design initiatives that align with organisational objectives. Experience with agile methodologies and full product lifecycle management, particularly in complex enterprise software environments. Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams, translating user needs into strategic design decisions that balance business goals with user outcomes. Expert-level proficiency in design methodology with exceptional attention to detail and deep understanding of how users engage with complex digital systems. Advanced skills in design and research tools including Figma, Miro, and project management platforms such as Jira. Strong foundation in design principles, typography, and accessibility standards (WCAG), with experience applying these in government or regulated environments. Passion for public good is a strong plus. Key Competencies : Product Leadership: Ability to define strategy, own outcomes, and lead multi-year product execution. Data-Driven Decision-Making: Able to translate data into actionable insights and financial intelligence. User-Centric Thinking : Designs with users in mind, balancing operational workflows with intuitive UX. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity. At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better. We empower our people to master their craft through continuous and robust learning and development opportunities all year round. Our GovTechies embody our Agile, Bold and Collaborative values to deliver impactful solutions. GovTech aims to transform the delivery of Government digital services by taking an "outside-in" view, putting citizens and businesses at the heart of everything we do. Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today! Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg. [What you will be working on] We are seeking a Product Manager to lead the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of internal digital products that enhance employee productivity and operational efficiency. These products support business-critical internal workflows (knowledge management, record management) or underpin key industry-facing services (e.g., grants management and licensing), enabling officers to deliver reliable services to the tourism sector. You are accountable for defining product direction and driving successful delivery, adoption and measurable outcomes for your product area. Product Strategy & Ownership Define and evolve product vision, roadmap and priorities for your product area to improve internal productivity and service outcomes. Translate operational needs into clear user stories, acceptance criteria and success metrics; maintain a prioritised backlog. Own the product lifecycle end-to-end (discovery → build → launch → iteration), ensuring outcomes are realised post-launch. Delivery Accountability Be accountable for delivery outcomes for your product area, including scope, timelines, quality, and operational readiness, working in partnership with engineering/delivery leads. Drive delivery planning with the team (milestones, release plan, dependencies) and keep stakeholders informed of progress and risks. Proactively manage delivery risks, issues and trade-offs; escalate early with options and recommendations. Ensure solutions are production-ready by working with engineering, architecture, security and operations on non-functional and run requirements (security, performance, supportability). Product Delivery & Execution Work with cross-functional teams (engineering, design, data/QA, operations) to deliver iterative releases while maintaining service continuity for critical operations. Prioritise work based on impact to productivity, service levels, compliance/audit needs, and user value. Run key product rituals (e.g., refinement, sprint planning support, demos) and keep documentation current (PRDs/user stories, release notes, operating procedures as needed). Process Transformation & Operational Efficiency Redesign and digitise end-to-end workflows (e.g., grants processing, licensing approvals, case handling), reducing manual effort and cycle time. Simplify complex business rules into scalable product and system design, balancing usability, controls and efficiency. Identify opportunities for automation, standardisation and reuse to improve productivity and reduce errors. Stakeholder Management Work closely with operational teams to understand real-world constraints, edge cases and service needs; translate these into practical product increments. Align stakeholders across policy, operations and technology on priorities, timelines and release scope; drive timely decisions. Communicate delivery progress, risks and outcomes clearly to product leadership and senior stakeholders. User & Outcome Focus Improve internal user experience to reduce friction, rework and training overhead through clear workflows, intuitive design and effective enablement. Define and track productivity and service metrics (e.g., turnaround time, throughput, backlog, error rates, adoption) and use insights to guide iteration. Ensure delivered changes achieve intended operational outcomes and are embedded into business-as-usual operations. Platform & Integration Thinking Ensure interoperability with enterprise systems and shared platforms (e.g., identity, data, workflow, integration), and manage integration dependencies. Contribute to reusable components and common patterns across internal workflow products to avoid siloed solutions. Governance, Risk & Compliance Ensure compliance with audit, data protection and security requirements; maintain traceability for financial and regulatory workflows. Identify and manage product and operational risks; ensure controls are designed into workflows without excessive burden on users. Budget & Procurement Management Own budget management for your product area (planning inputs, forecasting, utilisation tracking) and provide timely visibility of spend, variances and funding risks. Lead procurement activities required for delivery and continuity (e.g., licenses, subscriptions, professional services) in partnership with Finance/Procurement, ensuring governance and auditability. Support vendor evaluation and ongoing contract management by defining requirements, participating in evaluations, and monitoring service levels/renewals. [What we are looking for] Degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related discipline. Typically 4–7 years of relevant experience in product management, business transformation, digital delivery, or related roles. Track record delivering enterprise/internal-facing products or workflow systems with measurable operational impact (cycle time, quality, throughput, user satisfaction). Experience managing delivery in partnership with engineering teams (planning, prioritisation, risk management, release management). Exposure to budget and procurement processes (forecasting, utilisation tracking, licensing/professional services procurement, renewals) is an advantage. Working knowledge of security, data protection and audit/compliance needs in enterprise environments is an advantage. Outcome-oriented product thinking: frames problems clearly, defines success metrics, and prioritises work that delivers measurable impact. Strong execution and delivery discipline: plans work, manages risks and dependencies, and drives issues to resolution. Stakeholder management and communication: aligns teams, writes clearly, and can present options and trade-offs. User-centric approach: uses research, feedback and data to improve usability and adoption. Systems thinking: understands end-to-end workflows, data flows, controls and integration touchpoints. Comfort working with governance constraints (auditability, security, privacy) and designing practical solutions within them. What we offer you: GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation. Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs. We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you. Coordinate with DXD/ IT departments of respective MOE Statutory Boards and relevant system owners to facilitate a smooth audit process, minimize operational disruption and ensure timely audit completion. Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today! Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg. [About the role] As a Senior Product Manager, you will drive the development of one or more products under GovTech and manage the entire product lifecycle. You will develop product vision, design and manage product roadmaps based on the strategic goals of the agency you are serving. Working closely with colleagues specialising in user experience and engineering teams, you will conduct research, conceptualise features and ensure that they are rolled out successfully and on time. You will also define appropriate metrics, supervise consumer behaviour and perform data analysis to provide updates on feature performance. As a Senior Product Manager, you may mentor junior team members, fostering growth within the team. You will serve as a key liaison between business leadership and product teams, advocating for product needs and user insights. [What you will be working on] Product Strategy & Ownership Define and evolve product vision, roadmap and priorities for your product area to improve internal productivity and service outcomes. Translate operational needs into clear user stories, acceptance criteria and success metrics; maintain a prioritised backlog. Own the product lifecycle end-to-end (discovery → build → launch → iteration), ensuring outcomes are realised post-launch. Delivery Accountability Be accountable for delivery outcomes for your product area, including scope, timelines, quality, and operational readiness, working in partnership with engineering/delivery leads. Drive delivery planning with the team (milestones, release plan, dependencies) and keep stakeholders informed of progress and risks. Proactively manage delivery risks, issues and trade-offs; escalate early with options and recommendations. Ensure solutions are production-ready by working with engineering, architecture, security and operations on non-functional and run requirements (security, performance, supportability). Product Delivery & Execution Work with cross-functional teams (engineering, design, data/QA, operations) to deliver iterative releases while maintaining service continuity for critical operations. Prioritise work based on impact to productivity, service levels, compliance/audit needs, and user value. Run key product rituals (e.g., refinement, sprint planning support, demos) and keep documentation current (PRDs/user stories, release notes, operating procedures as needed). Process Transformation & Operational Efficiency Redesign and digitise end-to-end workflows (e.g., grants processing, licensing approvals, case handling), reducing manual effort and cycle time. Simplify complex business rules into scalable product and system design, balancing usability, controls and efficiency. Identify opportunities for automation, standardisation and reuse to improve productivity and reduce errors. Stakeholder Management Work closely with operational teams to understand real-world constraints, edge cases and service needs; translate these into practical product increments. Align stakeholders across policy, operations and technology on priorities, timelines and release scope; drive timely decisions. Communicate delivery progress, risks and outcomes clearly to product leadership and senior stakeholders. User & Outcome Focus Improve internal user experience to reduce friction, rework and training overhead through clear workflows, intuitive design and effective enablement. Define and track productivity and service metrics (e.g., turnaround time, throughput, backlog, error rates, adoption) and use insights to guide iteration. Ensure delivered changes achieve intended operational outcomes and are embedded into business-as-usual operations. Platform & Integration Thinking Ensure interoperability with enterprise systems and shared platforms (e.g., identity, data, workflow, integration), and manage integration dependencies. Contribute to reusable components and common patterns across internal workflow products to avoid siloed solutions. Governance, Risk & Compliance Ensure compliance with audit, data protection and security requirements; maintain traceability for financial and regulatory workflows. Identify and manage product and operational risks; ensure controls are designed into workflows without excessive burden on users. Budget & Procurement Management Own budget management for your product area (planning inputs, forecasting, utilisation tracking) and provide timely visibility of spend, variances and funding risks. Lead procurement activities required for delivery and continuity (e.g., licenses, subscriptions, professional services) in partnership with Finance/Procurement, ensuring governance and auditability. Support vendor evaluation and ongoing contract management by defining requirements, participating in evaluations, and monitoring service levels/renewals. [What we are looking for] Degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related discipline. Typically 4–7 years of relevant experience in product management, business transformation, digital delivery, or related roles. Track record delivering enterprise/internal-facing products or workflow systems with measurable operational impact (cycle time, quality, throughput, user satisfaction). Experience managing delivery in partnership with engineering teams (planning, prioritisation, risk management, release management). Exposure to budget and procurement processes (forecasting, utilisation tracking, licensing/professional services procurement, renewals) is an advantage. Working knowledge of security, data protection and audit/compliance needs in enterprise environments is an advantage. Outcome-oriented product thinking: frames problems clearly, defines success metrics, and prioritises work that delivers measurable impact. Strong execution and delivery discipline: plans work, manages risks and dependencies, and drives issues to resolution. Stakeholder management and communication: aligns teams, writes clearly, and can present options and trade-offs. User-centric approach: uses research, feedback and data to improve usability and adoption. Systems thinking: understands end-to-end workflows, data flows, controls and integration touchpoints. Comfort working with governance constraints (auditability, security, privacy) and designing practical solutions within them. What we offer you: GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation. Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs. We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you. Learn more about life inside GovTech at go.gov.sg/GovTechCareers. Stay connected with us on social media at go.gov.sg/ConnectWithGovTech

hrp|13245836|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-928a-4a8.description: The Finance and Facilities Division (FFD) is responsible for the Ministry’s financial matters, procurement management and general administration. hrp|13281627|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-af88-6ce.responsibilities: Partner internal customers to procure goods/services in a timely, effective and compliant manner, so as to enable IRAS to achieve its mission and objectives effectively and efficiently while ensuring public accountability. hrp|13342417|005056a3-53e2-1fd0-bae7-ad2.responsibilities: [What you will be working on] Your duties will include: Operate independently to conduct hydrographic surveys in Singapore waters in compliance with IHO S-44 standards. Operate, calibrate and maintain state-of-the-art hydrographic equipment Inform navigational safety decisions using hydrographic survey data Process and provide quality assurance for survey data Prepare survey reports Explore, assess and adopt new technologies (e.g. uncrewed platforms, AI and digital automation) to support hydrographic surveys Procurement of hydrographic survey equipment and services. Liaising with internal and external stakeholders, including management of vendors. Perform administrative roles such as notes taking, as well as the development/revision of SOP and ISO documents.
hrp|13342417|005056a3-53e2-1fd0-bae7-ad2.requirements: [What we are looking for] Candidate should possess relevant certification in disciplines such as Engineering, Surveying, Nautical Studies, Information Technology, Geomatics or Geospatial Information Sciences. You must be independent, meticulous with an eye for detail and a good team player with good interpersonal and communication skills. You will need to be able to embark and disembark small vessels at jetties using ladders or landing steps without external assistance, and work for extended periods aboard survey vessels. Candidates with no prior experience are welcomed to apply. Candidates with relevant experience in these areas may be offered positions at a higher level. In-house training will be provided. Provision of professional accreditation courses would be considered for suitable candidates.
hrp|13342417|005056a3-53e2-1fd0-bae7-ad2.description: [What the role is] Reporting to MPA's Hydrographic Division, candidate will be part of our team of maritime professionals whose responsibilities are to ensure safe navigation in Singapore waters by providing hydrographic, cartographic and aids to navigation products and services. The data collected from the hydrographic surveys are used for nautical charting for the safety of navigation in Singapore waters.

hrp|13758428|005056a3-53e2-1fd0-bfc3-25f.responsibilities: Manage the operations and maintenance, as well as enhancement of the network infrastructures such as the Fibre network, DataBridge and SWIM which are critical to ensure the safe provision of Air Navigation Services (ANS), in accordance to international standards and industry best practices. Work closely with various internal and external stakeholders including operational and technical users, consultants, system owners, auditors, regulators, original equipment manufacturers, vendors and contractors throughout the entire system lifecycle from project initiation to system replacement. Undertake project management activities including planning and budgeting, project tracking, contract variations and change request management and ensuring the overall quality and integrity of the project delivery. Undertake network and system integration activities and Application Programming Interface (API) and network infrastructure administration and management activities. Participate in system procurement activities including preparation of tender documentation, vendor evaluation and technical reviews. Implementation and deployment of systems, including activities such as testing, commissioning, and software upgrade activities. Willing and able to travel and attend local and/or overseas trainings, seminars, workshops and meetings, when required. Willing to work outside working hours occasionally for system maintenance/deployment activities and provide timely response on-site, when required. Perform any other requirements, tasks or related activities not stated but necessary for specified or intended use, where known
hrp|13758428|005056a3-53e2-1fd0-bfc3-25f.requirements: Trained in one of the following disciplines: Software Engineering, Electrical / Electronics / Computer Engineering/ Information Systems Management or equivalent Possess knowledge and experience on network infrastructure design, operations and deployment, management of network switches, firewalls and use of network management tools Possess knowledge in open standards, TCP/IP, HTTPS, AMQP, REST, SOLACE, DNS, Fibre Optics technology, Telecommunications standards, Linux/ Windows environment etc Good understanding of High Availability, Resiliency and Disaster Recovery and familiar with Cybersecurity principles and IT risk management Good understanding of relevant policies from respective Code of Practices, guidelines and best practices (e.g. IMDA’s COPIF, CSA’s CCoP and Govtech’s IM8) and be able to apply during project implementation Self-motivated, driven, assertive and analytical Positive work attitude and can work well in a team, as well as independently Excellent verbal, written communication and presentation skills Your appointment designation will commensurate with your relevant work experience. Successful candidates will be offered a 3-year contract in the first instance, and may be considered for placement on a permanent tenure or subsequent contract renewal.
hrp|13758428|005056a3-53e2-1fd0-bfc3-25f.description: We are seeking an esteemed engineer to be part of a multi-disciplinary team to perform system integration for the next generation Air Traffic Management Systems. You will be part of the team who is responsible for the project management and supervision of operations maintenance for our mission-critical backhaul and transmission networks and system infrastructure that support the Air Navigation Systems. The team will also perform network and system integration for Air Traffic Management Systems. There will be opportunities to work on network infrastructures such as the Fibre network, Data Bridge and System Wide Information Management (SWIM) that are critical to ensure our Air Navigation Systems continue to meet the dynamic demands of the Air Traffic Control (ATC) operations, thereby contributing indirectly to the safety and efficient management of air traffic movements in Singapore’s Flight Information Region.

hrp|14574175|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-8ab7-694.responsibilities: Responsibilities: • Plan and conduct internal audits according to the approved annual work plan to provide assurance that key controls risks are addressed. • Identify root cause and the risk implication of audit observations and work with divisions to identify relevant audit recommendations. • Evaluate corporate governance, risk management and control processes. • Assist in assurance, consulting engagements and investigations in conformance with ethical and professional standards. • Follow-up with divisions to ensure timely closure of recommendations from past audits conducted by internal audit. • Assist Head/IAU in administrative matters for IAU and ARC such as preparing requests for proposal and managing procurement process for IAU’s outsourced audits. • Be part of the secretariat team staffing the ARC • Any other duties as assigned
hrp|14574175|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-8ab7-694.requirements: Personal Competencies: - Good working knowledge and understanding of risk assessment, internal controls and adoption of data analytics - Strong analytical skills, resourceful, meticulous - Good communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills and able to interact with management at all levels Skills & Knowledge: - Stakeholder Management - Data Management & Analysis - Project Management Experience: - At least 4 years’ experience in conducting compliance or internal audits - Experience in managing project teams
hrp|14574175|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-8ab7-694.description: The Internal Audit Unit (IAU) in KidStart Singapore (KSL) is responsible for providing independent and objective assurance and consulting services to KSL management. The IAU helps KSL accomplish its objectives by bringing a systematic, disciplined approach to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of risk management, control, and governance processes. The IAU's main responsibilities include conducting internal audits and providing advisory services. Internal audits are conducted to assess the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls, compliance with policies and procedures and Code of Governance for Charities and Institutions of Public Character, and the reliability and integrity of financial and operational information. You will assist Head/IAU by working with the KSL Audit and Risk Committee (ARC) and Management to improve governance, risk management and streamline processes for greater operational effectiveness and efficiency.

hrp|14681650|005056a3-d347-1fe0-a580-847.requirements: Diploma/Degree in Computer Science, Infocomm Technology, Engineering or related subject area with minimum 5 years of relevant experience. Candidates with more years of experience will be considered for more senior roles Prior working experience in product management, IT business analysis, application solutioning design and testing Experience in modern product development/management technologies and practices such as Agile, Cloud, Design Thinking, and Product-Centric Development will be strongly preferred. Working directly with engineers, designers and other product managers (ideally at least 3 years). Strong analytical, conceptualisation and problem-solving skills Good communication skills with the ability to pitch ideas and influence A driven and motivated personality with an inquisitive mind Ability to learn and apply Relevant certifications such as CITPM, COMIT, PMP, and Certified Scrum Master. We also believe it’s important for you to keep honing your craft in the constantly-evolving tech landscape, so we provide and support a plethora of in-house and external learning and development opportunities all year round. hrp|14681650|005056a3-d347-1fe0-a580-847.description: The Government Technology Agency (GovTech) aims to transform the delivery of Government digital services and products by taking an "outside-in" view, putting citizens and businesses at the heart of everything we do. We also develop the Smart Nation infrastructure and applications and facilitate collaboration with citizens and businesses to co-develop technologies. Join us as we support Singapore’s vision of building a Smart Nation - a nation of possibilities empowered through info-communications technology and related engineering. Do you want to apply your skills, knowledge and energy to implement cutting-edge infocomm technology and digital solutions that will change the lives of Singaporeans and the public? In GovTech, you can! Product Managers make sure that the right things get done so that our digital products meet user needs and continuously remain relevant. At a high level, this means establishing a clear vision for what a product should be and what is needed to get there. On a day-to-day basis, this means handling all the different facets of a product and making sure they are coordinated – across user needs, technical constraints, and design goals.

hrp|14866267|005056a3-53e2-1fd0-bdbb-93f.responsibilities: Brief Description of Job Scope: We are looking for a pro-active and dynamic individual to join the Procurement Management Team. You would provide direction to Divisions for procurement operations and ensure that procurement practices are sound, effective, and aligned with MSF policies and processes. Responsibilities: Reporting to the Procurement Assistant Director, you will be part of a dynamic team that will be involved in the management of the Ministry's procurement. Your primary duties will involve the execution of procurement operations such as calling of quotations and tenders for goods and services requested by the Divisions using the Government Electronic Business System (GeBiz). You will be working with Divisions to develop appropriate procurement approaches to achieve effective procurement as well as provide support and professional procurement advice to ensure compliance with policies and processes. You will also be required to review internal procurement policies, collect and manage procurement data/information and translate them into reports for management reporting.
hrp|14866267|005056a3-53e2-1fd0-bdbb-93f.requirements: Competencies Required: • At least 3 years of relevant work experience • Having procurement experience in the Public Sector and practical experience in GeBiz operations • Collaborative team player • Strong analytical skills • Effective interpersonal and communication skills • Resourceful, pro-active and highly driven individual
hrp|14866267|005056a3-53e2-1fd0-bdbb-93f.description: The Finance and Facilities Division (FFD) is responsible for the Ministry’s financial matters, procurement management and general administration. FFD promotes proper stewardship of the Ministry’s resources by applying best practices across its various functions. The Procurement Management Unit oversees the Ministry’s procurement function and facilitates proper governance and internal controls through the setting of procurement policy and rendering of procurement advice.

PWDs are welcome to apply

hrp|15111955|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-a097-e4d.responsibilities: 1. Be involved in the development and taking-over of new building facilities with respect to testing & commissioning of M&E systems, collation of building & system defects, inspection of rectification works as well as ensuring post-construction documentation (such as asset list, operational & maintenance manuals, system / product warranties, as-built documents / drawings, etc) are updated / submitted promptly and filed systematically. 2. Prepare documents & drawings for the procurement of contracts & services for Facilities Management (FM), Building & M&E Maintenance, Upgrading / Retrofitting Work (including drafting of specifications, calling of tenders/ quotations, evaluation and award recommendations). 3. Oversee the daily operations, periodic inspections and maintenance of building infrastructural systems and facilities 4. Manage and oversee the FM Contractor(s)/sub-contractors to ensure performance efficacy and quality standards are achieved. 5. Conduct preventive & corrective maintenance audits and implement measures for environmental sustainability, automation, innovation and digitalisation. 6. Manage rectification work, additions & alternations (A&A) and interior fit-out projects (from conceptualisation, budgeting, execution and completion) within approved objectives, timeline and budget. 7. Identify potential issues/ areas for improvement to enhance facilities operations, building maintenance standards and efficiency and propose viable solutions/ suggestions. 8.Track & update inventory of building assets. 9. Coordinate and handle users’ requests & feedbacks and to ensure timely updates/ closure with the users. 10. Maintain good records / archives of all work & contractual correspondence.
hrp|15111955|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-a097-e4d.requirements: 1. Analytical reasoning, data synthesis and analysis 2. Have at least 8 years working experience in facilities and project management (e.g. retro-fitting / A&A work) for commercial / institutional / healthcare / hospitality facilities. 3. Be familiar with Public Sector procurement procedures and contracts administration. 4. Be a team player with strong analytical skills and is able to multi-task, work independently and collaboratively with stakeholders. 5. Be self- motivated, proactive, resourceful and has a keen eye for details. 6. Have good interpersonal, communication and organisational skills. 7. Be adept at administrative work, project and maintenance information management. 8. Be competent in the use of MS Office (Words, Excel, Powerpoint, etc), Tele-Conferencing Tools (MS Teams, Skype) and Sharepoint. 9. Preferably be competent in the use of Auto-Cad and Building Information Modelling (BIM). 10. Only Singaporeans need apply. We wish to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.
hrp|15111955|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-a097-e4d.description: ISD confronts and addresses threats to Singapore’s internal security and stability. For over 75 years, ISD and its predecessor organisations have played a central role in countering threats such as those posed by foreign subversive elements, spies, racial and religious extremists, and terrorists. A fulfilling and rewarding career awaits those who want to join in ISD’s critical mission of keeping Singapore safe, secure and sovereign for all Singaporeans. As an Infrastructure Executive (Facilities and Project), you will be involved in the operation, inspection and maintenance of new building facilities and M&E systems.

Coordinate and handle users’ requests & feedbacks and to ensure timely updates/ closure with the users. 10. Maintain good records / archives of all work & contractual correspondence.

hrp|15500021|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-97e4-a23.responsibilities: Responsibilities • Lead and conduct penetration testing, red teaming, and adversary simulation activities across web, mobile, infrastructure, cloud, OT, and telecommunications environments. • Execute realistic attack scenarios to assess the resilience of Critical Information Infrastructure (CII), including systems supporting essential services. • Support purple-teaming activities by translating offensive techniques into actionable detection and response improvements. • Lead engagements end-to-end, including planning, execution, reporting, and technical debriefs with stakeholders. • Mentor junior consultants and contribute to raising the team’s overall technical standard. • Drive continuous improvement of ASG’s testing methodologies, tooling, and research, including taking on problem spaces outside your primary domain when required. • And because this is government, be prepared to occasionally switch gears by contributing to strategic initiatives, supporting and executing procurement activities, participating in industry outreach, or undertaking coordination work, all of which ultimately help us strengthen security outcomes and make Singapore a safer place to live and work. Why Join ASG at CSA • Work on nationally significant systems, including CII, OT, and telecommunications environments rarely accessible outside government. • Engage in deep, technically challenging work that prioritises realism, learning, and security outcomes over high-volume testing. • Apply your offensive security expertise to a public mission that directly contributes to Singapore’s cyber resilience. • Be part of a specialist team that is deliberately building towards strong technical depth, continuous learning, and moving beyond compliance-driven assurance, and help shape what “good” looks like along the way.
hrp|15500021|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-97e4-a23.requirements: Requirements • An attacker’s mindset with strong technical understanding of operating systems, networks, and modern enterprise environments. • Proven ability to identify and execute real-world attack scenarios, beyond automated or checklist-based testing. • Experience in penetration testing and/or red team operations, with exposure to adversary tradecraft and attack chaining. • Demonstrated adaptability to transfer skills across technical domains (e.g. web to mobile, IT to OT, on-prem to cloud). • Strong technical writing skills and the ability to clearly articulate security risks and impact. • Typically 5–8 years of relevant experience in penetration testing, red team operations, or related offensive security roles, with demonstrated depth in hands-on technical work. • Relevant industry certifications such as OSCP, CREST (e.g. CRT, CCT), CRTO, or equivalent are desirable. That said, we recognise that certifications alone do not define capability. Hands-on experience, problem-solving ability, and technical depth matter more to us than badges. If you share our passion to make a difference in the cyber security landscape, take up the challenge and apply now. All applicants will be notified on whether they are shortlisted or not within 4 weeks of the closing date of this job posting. For any issues with the application, you may drop your resume with us at csa_recruit@csa.gov.sg.
hrp|15500021|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-97e4-a23.description: You will be part of the Attack Simulation Group (ASG) within the Cyber Security Agency of Singapore (CSA), a specialist team responsible for delivering advanced security testing and adversary-led assessments to strengthen the resilience of Critical Information Infrastructure (CII). This is a senior, hands-on role for experienced offensive security practitioners who want to apply real-world attack techniques to complex, high-impact systems in support of Singapore’s national cyber security mission. The Team ASG is a technically driven team within CSA focused on realistic attack simulation, penetration testing, red teaming, and purple-teaming outcomes. Our work goes beyond compliance-driven assurance, emphasising hands-on testing, attacker tradecraft, and practical security improvements. Operating within the realities of government, we value curiosity, adaptability, and out-of-the-box thinking. Specialised training and development opportunities are provided to continuously deepen and expand our technical capabilities, and team members are expected to continuously learn, apply skills across domains, and contribute to the evolution of attack simulation practices across Singapore’s CII. We also believe in sharing and growing our craft where appropriate. Some of our public work and tooling can be found at: 👉 https://github.com/hack-techv2/

hrp|15895918|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-849e-a91.responsibilities: You will play a key role in the Procurement team in the CDA. hrp|16092265|005056a3-d347-1fe0-bef7-b73.responsibilities: You will be the Procurement Officer reporting to the Team lead, Procurement. In this role, you will be part of the team to partner business units to deliver efficient and timely procurement operations while ensuring assurance through understanding business needs and the operating environment, leveraging on technology to enhance users’ experience. In this role, you will, Support Business Units in their procurement process and partner project officers to: Plan the project’s procurement needs while ensuring alignment to SportSG Procurement Regulations and the IM. Develop procurement timeline and milestones based on their specific needs. Manage the calling of Quotations and Tenders. Provide advice to project teams on post contract management. Implement policies and process and review process with outsourced vendor and internal stakeholders to enhance efficiency and achieve value-for-money procurement. Manage and ensure timely execution of all the following GeBIZ procurement processes for Quotations and Tenders.
hrp|16092265|005056a3-d347-1fe0-bef7-b73.requirements: We are looking for self-motivated individuals who value integrity, teamwork and take pride in going the extra mile to provide excellent service to stakeholders and the community. This individual should be a sport advocate through living an active lifestyle and staying active. In addition, an ideal candidate should possess the following: Minimum 2 years of relevant working experience in procurement. Excellent written, communication, and interpersonal skills. Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities. Organised, meticulous, proactive, and resourceful. Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team. Knowledge in GeBIZ, data analytics, RPA would be advantageous. The level of offer will commensurate with applicants’ experience and track records. Successful candidates will be offered a 3-year contract in the first instance.
hrp|16092265|005056a3-d347-1fe0-bef7-b73.description: At Sport Singapore, we aspire to transform the nation through an active lifestyle designed around innovative, fun and meaningful sporting experiences. Sport has the unique ability to bring people together through play, regardless of age, gender, race, ability or social status. It imparts life values, nurtures character and builds resilience. It inspires and evokes the Singapore spirit through shared experiences and strengthens our national identity. We help Singaporeans Live Better Through Sport. Sport Singapore is constantly on the lookout for individuals who are passionate about what they do. Anchored in our values of Passion for Sport, Strength through Teamwork and Care for People, we believe in working and playing, not just as a team, but as a family.

hrp|16102441|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-89a1-0b9.responsibilities: Join a team of changemakers on a mission to redesign the motoring experience – creating a future where transactions happen effortlessly, touchpoints are thoughtfully designed, and where every interaction in a delight. You will be part of a team to reinvent the One Motoring platform, building new capabilities to enable real-time billing, personalised dashboards, and intuitive user flows. You will coordinate and manage resources, lifecycles, and budgets while liaising between design, technical, product, and business teams to drive successful project execution that enables large-scale digital change. What You’ll Do Project Leadership: Oversee the full project lifecycle, from initial conceptualisation and solution design through to implementation and ongoing system maintenance. Procurement & Vendor Management: Build strong partnerships by leading procurement processes, crafting robust tender specifications, and fostering vendor relationships that drive exceptional project outcomes. Stakeholder Management: Lead stakeholder engagement and manage relationships across internal and external partners to ensure sustained alignment and buy-in. Lead Technical Tests: Perform code and architecture reviews and lead software testing. You will approve test plans proposed by the vendors and supervise the testing process. Support Agile Software Development: Define and drive agile best practices with the vendor, bridging communication between designers, architects, and the vendors. Track Deliverables & Milestones: Maintain clear project timelines, monitor deliverables, ensure project documentation is maintained and proactively manage risks. Risk & Compliance Management: Identify and mitigate project risks while ensuring adherence to government IT governance, frameworks, and contractual obligations.
hrp|16102441|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-89a1-0b9.requirements: Knowledge in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent technical background. You have 7+ years of experience with at least 3 years in technical project management, senior or lead roles, preferably within government or regulated industries. You must have a Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent technical background with demonstrated expertise in enterprise-scale systems. You have extensive experience managing complex procurement processes exceeding $1M in value, including multi-vendor contract management, change management. Knowledge of public sector regulations and compliance frameworks is preferred. You must have strong technical acumen and can conduct code reviews and architecture assessments. You have hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), microservices architecture, and modern DevSecOps practices including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and security scanning tools. You are certified in agile methodologies (Scrum Master, Product Owner, or equivalent) with proven experience scaling agile practices across large, distributed teams. You have deep expertise in software design principles, enterprise architecture patterns, API design and complex system integrations. You have excellent stakeholder management skills , with the ability to communicate effectively with vendors, engineers, cross-functional teams, and the product leadership. You are highly organised and detail-oriented and can deftly manage multiple asks and workstreams while keeping projects on track. You are strategically minded with strong business acumen , capable of translating technical complexities into business value propositions. You have experience with budget management, resource planning, and can effectively manage multiple concurrent projects worth millions in combined value while maintaining rigorous quality standards. As part of the shortlisting process for the role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and / or undergo further assessment.

hrp|16125414|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-94c5-b9f.responsibilities: The ATMSSP is responsible for conceptualization, implementation, and management of multiple IT and Operational Technology (OT) systems. In this role, the officer is expected to undertake the following areas of work: Radar Project Delivery Plan and manage Radar projects and ensure alignment of project to the user objectives within established scope, cost and schedule Coordinate and work with other teams for building and network infrastructure integration, ATM integrations and resolve deployment and integration issues Lead and liaise with other technical teams to resolve impediments, incidents and issues Governance, Risk and Compliance Ensure system compliance to CAAS and Government (Instruction Manual 8 and Cybersecurity Code of Practice) requirements, policies and standards Ensure risk and safety framework is adhered to and carry out risk and safety management for radar projects Identify and mitigating risks which may impact the successful delivery of the radar systems Supporting audit and addressing findings Vendor contracting and management Managed vendors and contractors to meet the project delivery and operation needs Perform procurement of the systems, including its evaluation of the proposed solutions Stakeholder management Work closely with multiple stakeholders both internal and external (including other government agencies, system suppliers, maintenance operators, operation users, IT consultants/auditors etc.) Coordinate, liaise, support and conduct meetings to facilitate and validate the implementation in accordance with national and international cybersecurity standards and requirements
hrp|16125414|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-94c5-b9f.requirements: Trained in Electrical or Electronics Engineering or equivalent with preferably 3-5 years of relevant working experience in project management and system implementation Experience in project management, vendor management, incident management, problem management Experiences with the operations or maintenance of safety critical systems (for example radars) are preferred Possesses knowledge or understanding of Radar systems’ architectures and environments Strong experience in managing business, IT and senior stakeholders Sound understanding of the technical aspects of systems integration in an environment with diverse technologies Strong communication skills and ability to influence to gain consensus from multiple stakeholders when required Familiarity with Government IM8 and CCoP and ATM domain will be an added advantage Good analytical skills, and able to multi-task and deliver results in a timely manner Excellent technical troubleshooting skills Self-driven, creative and team-oriented person with good interpersonal and organizational skills, positive attitude and able to work under pressure Ability to travel for overseas visits, meetings and training Your appointment designation will commensurate with your relevant work experience. Successful candidates will be offered a 3-year contract in the first instance, and may be considered for placement on a permanent tenure or subsequent contract renewal.
hrp|16125414|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-94c5-b9f.description: CAAS Next Generation Programme Office is looking for a strong, driven, and dynamic esteemed engineer candidate to be part of the team. You will be part of the multi-disciplinary team overseeing the entire life cycle management of next generation Radar Systems, starting from system planning and system design phase to implementation phase and transiting to operations and maintenance phase.

hrp|16285094|005056a3-d347-1fe1-a091-9c4.responsibilities: The job description of a Deputy Principal/Senior/Executive Engineer at Semakau Landfill (SL) / Tuas Marine Transfer Station (TMTS) are as follows: Take charge of the planning, organizing and implementation of a structured operation and maintenance (O&M) programme, command centre for the waste receiving operations at SL and TMTS, and upcoming projects at SL. Prepare specifications and call tenders / quotations for the O&M works, procurement of spare parts, consultancy study and/or construction of new and/or refurbishment work of facility / infrastructure at SL / TMTS and administer the Contract. Lead Engineering Managers and Senior Engineering Executives to supervise the O&M contractors to manage landfilling operations. Review and manage safety and security of the infrastructure to mitigate potential hazards and threats within SL and TMTS. To assist in coordination/monitoring of NEA or external agencies/parties’ projects or works if assigned. Is expected to participate in projects related to operational work to improve our process. Involve in ISO9001/14001, ECO office, energy efficiency, sustainability and other organizational development activities or projects. Perform any other duties and responsibilities as assigned by the Branch Heads.
hrp|16285094|005056a3-d347-1fe1-a091-9c4.requirements: Bachelor’s degree in any engineering discipline recognised by the Professional Engineer Board. At least 3 years of working experience in consultancy, construction or infrastructure industry. Candidate with project management, procurement and contract management experience is preferred. Possess analytical, problem-solving and leadership skills. Able to work independently and possess good interpersonal skills. Leadership skill to lead a team to carry out work on site. A team player with positive working attitude. Able to work under pressure and cope with tight deadlines. Able to work in a fast-paced and highly volatile environment that would require the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders at the same time. Possess good verbal and written communication skills. Working locations: Semakau Landfill (offshore) or Tuas Marine Transfer Station As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment.
hrp|16285094|005056a3-d347-1fe1-a091-9c4.description: Landfill Management and Operations Department (LMOD) oversees Semakau Landfill which is Singapore’s only landfill for waste disposal.

hrp|16453109|005056a3-d347-1fe1-aa93-c89.description: What you will be working on: • Engage residents and community partners to understand ground needs, gather feedback, and co-create programmes and solutions that strengthen community connectedness and advance PA's People-to-People, People-to-Government, and Government-to-People objectives. • Plan and execute community activities, programmes, and initiatives at the GRO and divisional levels, including national campaigns organised by PA, the CDC, and GROs, to widen outreach and deepen resident engagement. • Facilitate the formation and development of interest groups, informal committees, and local communication networks, and coordinate the recruitment, appointment, and reappointment of volunteers and GRO members in accordance with GRO Rules & Regulations and succession planning considerations. • Attend monthly GRO meetings, provide administrative and logistical support to GROs, and submit timely progress reports to PA HQ to ensure effective implementation of community activities. • Manage GROs' social media platforms and digital assets, develop communications and marketing materials in accordance with PA guidelines, and communicate government policies to the community with appropriate cultural sensitivity. • Ensure proper financial management of GROs, including monitoring budgets, preparing grant papers, and working with the CO Finance Coordinator and GCDO Field Governance to ensure timely preparation of accounts and audit readiness in compliance with PA's Financial Rules and Regulations. • Manage procurement processes, including drafting specifications and procurement papers for ITQs and ITTs, ensuring compliance with PA's procurement guidelines. • Maintain accurate records and data, including engagement data, correspondence, and finance documents, ensuring proper handling and storage of personal data in compliance with data protection policies and IM8 Data and Incident Management rules. What we are looking for • Experience - Prior experience in community engagement, social work, grassroots development, or a people-facing role is preferred; candidates with strong co-curricular involvement and demonstrated leadership will also be considered. • Skills - Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to engage residents and stakeholders from diverse backgrounds; proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; familiarity with social media platforms (e.g. Facebook, Instagram, TikTok) for community outreach purposes. • Nice-to-have - Proficiency in a second language (Malay, Mandarin, Tamil, or a dialect) to engage residents from diverse communities; experience in financial administration or procurement (Only shortlisted candidates will be notified) Shortlisted candidates will go through PA’s structured interview. Successful candidates will be given a 3-year contract and deployed to CO/CC.

hrp|16462195|005056a3-d347-1fe1-86fe-b7a.responsibilities: With our increasing number of rail and road projects, there are always new contracts being formed to support such projects so as to keep Singapore's public transport system going and growing. LTA Safety & Contracts group plays a critical role in procuring contracts and managing contractual issues for all our various land transport projects. You will work on a diverse range of IT & Other Systems; Transport Systems; and/or Electrical & Mechanical Services contracts. Your key role is to ensure contract governance, and all tender and contract administration processes comply with the LTA’s requirements and procedures. You will be involved in preparing cost estimates for new projects / initiatives / feasibility studies, drafting tender documents, evaluating tenders, administrating contracts (e.g. processing of payments, valuation of variations, assessment of claims) and providing contractual advice to project teams.
hrp|16462195|005056a3-d347-1fe1-86fe-b7a.requirements: • Knowledge in Computer / Electrical / Electronics / Information Technology / Mechanical / Systems Engineering • At least 2 years of working experience in contract administration or project management of multi-disciplinary engineering projects is preferred • Good knowledge of conditions of contract for IT, engineering or construction projects is preferred • Organized and meticulous with the ability to work independently • Strong written, analytical, communication and interpersonal skills • A team player and able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment • Those without working experience are also welcome to apply As part of the shortlisting process for the role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and / or undergo further assessment.

hrp|16462206|005056a3-d347-1fe1-a38a-84f.responsibilities: Key responsibilities include: Engage internal and external stakeholders to gather project requirements and conduct market surveys where necessary. Design system architectures and formulate technical specifications for assigned project(s). Support the design of integration solutions between various systems, applications, and databases using APIs, middleware, and other relevant technologies. Support the identification and resolution of integration issues to ensure system stability and reliability. Support the coordination and monitoring of integrated system performance, as well as the development of integration testing plans. Seek approvals from relevant authorities for procurement, system design, and technical specifications, as required. Ensure timely project delivery in accordance with approved scope, schedule, and budget, while meeting operational needs and objectives. Identify project risks, assess their impact, and recommend mitigation measures to minimise delays and operational impact. Review and ensure that project documentation (e.g. system design documents, site acceptance test documents, interface control documents) is accurate, complete, and delivered on time. Work with relevant stakeholders to manage and enhance the cybersecurity posture (e.g. cyber defences and mitigation measures) of the system to meet CAAS, national, and international standards and requirements. Engage stakeholders to ensure systems are properly integrated, tested, and ready to support air traffic operations. Provide regular project updates to management and highlight potential issues and proposed resolutions in a timely manner.
hrp|16462206|005056a3-d347-1fe1-a38a-84f.requirements: Degree or Diploma in Engineering (Computing, Electrical, Electronics, Telecommunications), Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent relevant experience. Experience delivering large-scale ICT systems across the full system lifecycle, including working with vendors and contractors on design reviews, implementation oversight, testing, acceptance, and operational handover. Knowledge of system architecture design, system administration, networking, cybersecurity, and/or the air traffic management domain is an advantage. Professional certifications such as Cloud Solution Architect, SysOps Administrator, Project Management Professional (PMP), Agile Project Management, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), or equivalent are advantageous. Self-motivated, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability; able to work independently and collaboratively as a team player. Good written, verbal, interpersonal, analytical, presentation, and negotiation skills, with a positive attitude and attention to detail. Willingness to travel overseas occasionally. Your appointment designation will commensurate with your relevant work experience. Successful candidates will be offered a 3-year contract in the first instance and may be considered for placement on a permanent tenure or subsequent contract renewal.
hrp|16462206|005056a3-d347-1fe1-a38a-84f.description: The Next Generation Programme Office (NGPO) in CAAS is seeking a strong, driven, and dynamic engineer to be part of the Info-Centric Air Traffic Management (iATM) workstream. You will be part of the team overseeing the implementation of Next Generation iATM systems, including (but not limited to) flight plan filing and air traffic flow management. You will play a key role across multiple phases of the project lifecycle, such as approvals, procurement, implementation, testing, maintenance, and system enhancements. Depending on the project phase, you will work with relevant stakeholders to define system architectures, gather requirements, formulate technical specifications, manage procurement processes, and oversee system implementation, commissioning, maintenance, and enhancements in accordance with Singapore Government and applicable international standards (e.g. SG IM8, ICAO). You will also support the implementation of cyber and data security measures and contribute to the safe and efficient management of air traffic in Singapore.
