hrp|16549870|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-80da-0a7.responsibilities: We are looking for strong and dynamic candidates to be part of the Digital Development team in CAAS’ Transformation Office. Together, you will help to achieve CAAS’ digital transformation strategic outcomes – by supporting our IT modernisation efforts and overseeing the maintenance and support of existing enterprise IT application systems. You will be working closely with business users and vendors, ensuring system compliance with government IM8 policies, and identifying improvements to enhance business operations and delivery of CAAS’ e-services. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, project management skills, and business acumen to manage ICT systems that support CAAS's operational excellence. Key responsibilities include: 1) Support the maintenance and support of CAAS enterprise IT systems. This requires: - working closely with CAAS business users in scoping user requirements - budgeting and procurement of professional services to maintain and support ICT systems - strong project management and stakeholder engagement to ensure timely delivery and cost effectiveness 2) Manage CAAS’ ICT vendors to ensure high quality delivery of services 3) Support maintenance of existing CAAS enterprise IT systems to ensure their smooth operations and availability, including management of contracts and change/service requests 4) Ensure that CAAS enterprise IT systems comply with prevailing government IM8 policies and requirements 5) Regularly identify and exploit appropriate technology, review and improve customers' work processes and conduct business process re-engineering when required
hrp|16549870|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-80da-0a7.requirements: Requirements Trained in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering (Computing/Telecommunication) or equivalent At least 3 years of relevant working experience in IT project management in the scoping, design, development, implementation and maintenance of web-based application systems Minimum 2 years of IT knowledge in Web Development, Cloud Technologies, Cloud Security, Agile Methodology, Database Management, and Troubleshooting and Technical Support Working knowledge of Cloud Service Providers, Cybersecurity, and ICT governance will be an added advantage Good knowledge of computer concepts such as Operating Systems, Networking, Virtualization, Web Technologies, Deployment and DevOps, Security Best Practices, Self-motivated, driven, adaptable to change, with problem-solving mindset, good team player and strong ability to multi-task Good verbal, written communication and interpersonal skills, with experience in stakeholder management and technical documentation Good analytical, presentation and negotiation skills, including vendor management experience Note: Your appointment designation will commensurate with your relevant work experience. Successful candidates will be offered a 3-year contract in the first instance, and may be considered for placement on a permanent tenure or subsequent contract renewal.

hrp|16564751|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-86a0-3a9.responsibilities: The temporary staff member will collaborate closely with the Team Lead and key stakeholders to deliver essential planning, implementation, and operational support for scaling SportCares' specialised programmes. These include the Morning Exercise and Gym-in-a-Bag initiatives, designed to reach vulnerable seniors living in rental housing effectively, educing social isolation and enhancing their well-being in line a with the organisation’s mission to uplift underserved communities through sport. Job Responsibilities: • Support the team in designing, implementing, monitoring & evaluation of Morning Exercise programme and other initiatives to impact the lives of isolated seniors living in rental blocks. • Build and maintain strategic partnerships with new/existing stakeholders across relevant sectors to expand programme outreach. • Develop comprehensive indicators and measurement frameworks to assess programme effectiveness and provide evidence-based reporting on outcomes. • Oversee programme procurement activities within approved budgets and timelines, ensuring compliance with government procurement guidelines. • Evaluate suppliers and service providers, manage vendor relationships and performance, and ensure procurement processes meet regulatory standards. • Work closely with internal teams including Finance and Procurement to ensure funding availability and maintain prudent procurement practices.
hrp|16564751|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-86a0-3a9.requirements: We are looking for self-motivated individuals who value integrity, teamwork and take pride in going the extra mile to provide excellent service to stakeholders and the community. This individual should be a sport advocate through living an active lifestyle and staying active. In addition, an ideal candidate should possess the following: • Tertiary Education in a relevant field such as Sport Science & Management / Social Work / Sociology is advantageous. • Minimum 2 years’ experience in organizing and implementing programmes and outreach (not necessary sports related) to vulnerable children & youth, families, persons with disabilities, and/or seniors. • Experience in programme design, monitoring & evaluation. • An understanding of Singapore sporting ecosystem. • Experience working in the social service sector is advantageous. • Strong interpersonal skills. • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage diverse stakeholders effectively. • Strong organisational, project management, and administrative capabilities with attention to detail.
hrp|16564751|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-86a0-3a9.description: At Sport Singapore, we aspire to transform the nation through an active lifestyle designed around innovative, fun, and meaningful sporting experiences. Sport has the unique ability to bring people together through play, regardless of age, gender, race, ability, or social status. It imparts life values, nurtures character and builds resilience. It inspires and evokes the Singapore spirit through shared experiences and strengthens our national identity. We help Singaporeans Live Better Through Sport. Sport Singapore is constantly on the lookout for individuals who are passionate about what they do. Anchored in our values of Passion for Sport, Strength through Teamwork and Care for People, we believe in working and playing, not just as a team, but as a family. The level of offer will commensurate with applicants’ experience and track records. Successful candidates will be offered a 12-months Full-time contract. Only shortlisted applicants will be notified.

Job Responsibilities: • Support the team in designing, implementing, monitoring & evaluation of Morning Exercise programme and other initiatives to impact the lives of isolated seniors living in rental blocks. • Build and maintain strategic partnerships with new/existing stakeholders across relevant sectors to expand programme outreach. • Develop comprehensive indicators and measurement frameworks to assess programme effectiveness and provide evidence-based reporting on outcomes. • Oversee programme procurement activities within approved budgets and timelines, ensuring compliance with government procurement guidelines. • Evaluate suppliers and service providers, manage vendor relationships and performance, and ensure procurement processes meet regulatory standards. • Work closely with internal teams including Finance and Procurement to ensure funding availability and maintain prudent procurement practices.
hrp|16564751|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-97e8-101.requirements: We are looking for self-motivated individuals who value integrity, teamwork and take pride in going the extra mile to provide excellent service to stakeholders and the community. This individual should be a sport advocate through living an active lifestyle and staying active. In addition, an ideal candidate should possess the following: • Tertiary Education in a relevant field such as Sport Science & Management / Social Work / Sociology is advantageous. • Minimum 2 years’ experience in organizing and implementing programmes and outreach (not necessary sports related) to vulnerable children & youth, families, persons with disabilities, and/or seniors. • Experience in programme design, monitoring & evaluation. • An understanding of Singapore sporting ecosystem. • Experience working in the social service sector is advantageous. • Strong interpersonal skills. • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage diverse stakeholders effectively. • Strong organisational, project management, and administrative capabilities with attention to detail.
hrp|16564751|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-97e8-101.description: At Sport Singapore, we aspire to transform the nation through an active lifestyle designed around innovative, fun, and meaningful sporting experiences. Sport has the unique ability to bring people together through play, regardless of age, gender, race, ability, or social status. It imparts life values, nurtures character and builds resilience. It inspires and evokes the Singapore spirit through shared experiences and strengthens our national identity. We help Singaporeans Live Better Through Sport. Sport Singapore is constantly on the lookout for individuals who are passionate about what they do. Anchored in our values of Passion for Sport, Strength through Teamwork and Care for People, we believe in working and playing, not just as a team, but as a family. The level of offer will commensurate with applicants’ experience and track records. Successful candidates will be offered a 12-months Full-time contract. Only shortlisted applicants will be notified.

network automation to support MAS's critical information infrastructure Develop and maintain network architecture roadmaps aligned with organisational strategies, ensuring resilience and security of operations Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance on complex network solutions including data centre networking, operational observability, security infrastructure, and hybrid cloud connectivity Review and validate technical designs from project teams and vendors, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, observability and security requirements Lead technical assessments and proof-of-concepts for new technologies and solutions Stakeholder Engagement & Mentorship: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver secure network infrastructure solutions in hybrid technology operating environment that meet stringent regulatory and operational requirements Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the network services team, fostering innovation and best on strategic initiatives and architectural reviews
hrp|16632287|005056a3-53e2-1fd0-bfaa-086.requirements: Minimum 10 years of experience in network architecture and infrastructure design, with at least 5 years in a senior architect or technical leadership capacity Proven experience designing and implementing large-scale network infrastructure in enterprise or financial services environments Experience with critical information infrastructure protection and regulatory compliance requirements Minimum 5 years of experience in technology procurement, vendor management, or contract negotiations for network infrastructure solutions, preferably in government or highly regulated environments Wireless Technologies: Proficient in enterprise wireless solutions including Wi-Fi deployment, wireless controller management, and RF planning and optimisation. WAN Connectivity: Extensive experience with WAN technologies including MPLS, SD-WAN solutions, VPN implementations, and hybrid connectivity architectures End User Computing: Strong understanding of endpoint technologies like Network Access Control (NAC), and ClearPass Policy Manager (CPPM) for device authentication and authorisation. hrp|16644437|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-80e5-b6f.responsibilities: As a Records Management and Procurement Records Management and Procurement Senior Assistant Executive/ Executive, you’ll play a vital role as a member in the Corporate Development Division ensuring the effective management of Ministry of Transport (MOT)’s records, information, procurement, compliance, and governance. Responsibilities include and not limited to: (Strategic Management) Being part of a dynamic team that leads both MOT’s records management and procurement strategy, including reviewing taxonomy and metadata structures to ensure effective organization and retrieval of information. Ensuring the Transparency, Open and Fair competition and Value for Money for Government procurement. (Systems Oversight) Manage MOT’s records management systems, ensuring they are up-to-date, user-friendly, and compliant with regulations. (Collaboration) Liaise with the National Archives of Singapore and internal divisions to facilitate records appraisal, transfer, disposition, and declassification processes. (Performance Evaluation) Analyse filing activities and assess the effectiveness of MOT’s record management systems, recommending improvements as needed. (Staff Training) Plan and coordinate data strategy initiatives and sharing sessions to educate MOT staff on records management, procurement requirements and processes, promoting a culture of compliance and efficiency. (Digitisation Projects) Systematically pack and organise files whilst creating accurate metadata to ensure proper records classification, long-term preservation, and efficient accessibility of organisational information. (Administrative Support) Manage day-to-day administrative operations, ensuring timely processing and compliance with guidelines. (Procurement) Oversee the Ministry’s procurement operations, including reviewing proposals and requirement specifications, providing guidance on policies and processes, and managing quotation and tender exercises via GeBIZ. (Communication) Develop and produce collateral to support publicity and internal communication efforts related to records management and procurement initiatives. (Ad Hoc Tasks) Undertake any other duties as assigned by the Division Director or Section Head, contributing to the overall effectiveness of Ministry of Transport’s Corporate Development Division.
hrp|16644437|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-80e5-b6f.requirements: The officer should be a Singapore citizen with some relevant working experience. The officer should possess good interpersonal, organisational, written and communication skills. The officer is expected to be an independent worker with strong computer literacy and good initiative, as well as a meticulous, self-motivated, resourceful and committed team player. Join and be part of our dynamic team at Ministry of Transport.
hrp|16644437|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-80e5-b6f.description: Singapore is internationally renowned for our transport infrastructure and for being a global aviation and maritime hub. At the Ministry of Transport (MOT), we spearhead developments in our air, land and sea transport sectors to advance Singapore’s economic competitiveness and Singaporeans’ quality of life. We seek dynamic, analytical and committed individuals to join our able MOT team in realising our vision of a global interconnected transport hub. If you share our vision and possess the qualities we seek, do join us!

hrp|16644437|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-8984-a1e.responsibilities: As a Records Management and Procurement Records Management and Procurement Senior Assistant Executive/ Executive, you’ll play a vital role as a member in the Corporate Development Division ensuring the effective management of Ministry of Transport (MOT)’s records, information, procurement, compliance, and governance. Responsibilities include and not limited to: (Strategic Management) Being part of a dynamic team that leads both MOT’s records management and procurement strategy, including reviewing taxonomy and metadata structures to ensure effective organization and retrieval of information. Ensuring the Transparency, Open and Fair competition and Value for Money for Government procurement. (Systems Oversight) Manage MOT’s records management systems, ensuring they are up-to-date, user-friendly, and compliant with regulations. (Collaboration) Liaise with the National Archives of Singapore and internal divisions to facilitate records appraisal, transfer, disposition, and declassification processes. (Performance Evaluation) Analyse filing activities and assess the effectiveness of MOT’s record management systems, recommending improvements as needed. (Staff Training) Plan and coordinate data strategy initiatives and sharing sessions to educate MOT staff on records management, procurement requirements and processes, promoting a culture of compliance and efficiency. (Digitisation Projects) Systematically pack and organise files whilst creating accurate metadata to ensure proper records classification, long-term preservation, and efficient accessibility of organisational information. (Administrative Support) Manage day-to-day administrative operations, ensuring timely processing and compliance with guidelines. (Procurement) Oversee the Ministry’s procurement operations, including reviewing proposals and requirement specifications, providing guidance on policies and processes, and managing quotation and tender exercises via GeBIZ. (Communication) Develop and produce collateral to support publicity and internal communication efforts related to records management and procurement initiatives. (Ad Hoc Tasks) Undertake any other duties as assigned by the Division Director or Section Head, contributing to the overall effectiveness of Ministry of Transport’s Corporate Development Division.
hrp|16644437|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-8984-a1e.requirements: The officer should be a Singapore citizen with some relevant working experience. The officer should possess good interpersonal, organisational, written and communication skills. The officer is expected to be an independent worker with strong computer literacy and good initiative, as well as a meticulous, self-motivated, resourceful and committed team player. Join and be part of our dynamic team at Ministry of Transport.
hrp|16644437|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-8984-a1e.description: Singapore is internationally renowned for our transport infrastructure and for being a global aviation and maritime hub. At the Ministry of Transport (MOT), we spearhead developments in our air, land and sea transport sectors to advance Singapore’s economic competitiveness and Singaporeans’ quality of life. We seek dynamic, analytical and committed individuals to join our able MOT team in realising our vision of a global interconnected transport hub. If you share our vision and possess the qualities we seek, do join us!

hrp|16651012|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-85c5-625.responsibilities: We are seeking a proactive and dynamic individual to join the ITG’s Procurement Team. You would be: a. The person-in-charge for the centralised consultation process of IT-related purchases. b. The purchasing officer for payment processing. c. Overall oversight of all ITG contracts to ensure that contracts are reviewed and renewed in a timely manner. Key Responsibilities: a. Manage the centralised consultation process of IT-related purchases. Working with IT teams and reporting to the ITG Procurement team, you will: • Plan and execute consultation operations for IT-related purchases from Groups/Divisions. • Guide Groups/Divisions through the IT pre-procurement consultation process, ensuring sound and effective outcomes. • Have oversight of all IT-related pre-procurement consultations from Groups/Divisions, and hardware and software which are managed in central register. • Review processes and establish guidelines to enhance the overall pre-procurement consultation framework. b. As purchasing officer for payment processing, you will ensure e-invoices from the Agency's Finance System are processed accurately within specified timeframes by: • Retrieving e-invoices from the Agency's Finance System. • Liaising with Verifying Officers (VOs) to obtain necessary supporting documents and ensure due diligence. • Confirming VO verification and document submission via email responses. • Filing supporting documents in the central repository. • Verifying accuracy of cost centre and accounting information in the Agency’s Finance System. • Routing e-invoices to Certifying Officers (COs) for processing. • Following up with VOs and COs to ensure timely action on e-invoices. c. To maintain oversight of ITG contracts holistically, you will work with the respective teams on: • Maintaining a centralised repository of all ITG contracts with visibility across ITG. • Tracking contract values, including funding obtained, approval limits, and exercised amounts to ensure compliance with budgetary and procurement requirements. • Monitoring contract validity periods and performance milestones to proactively initiate renewals, variations, or procurement activities in a timely manner.
hrp|16651012|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-85c5-625.requirements: Competencies required: • Minimum qualification: Diploma. • Good command of spoken and written English. • Competent in managing data using Excel, Word, PowerPoint. • Good analytical and problem-solving skills and able to adapt quickly to evolving situations. • Good interpersonal and communication skills. • Responsive, prompt and supportive in addressing IT teams' and Groups/Divisions' needs. • Is resourceful and can multi-task in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines. • Effective stakeholder engagement and relationship management.

Our areas of expertise include product development and operations management, network infrastructure, cybersecurity, and data analytics. We are committed to delivering reliable, user-friendly technology solutions that enable the Ministry to better serve the community.

hrp|16704109|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-80c0-e51.responsibilities: SWIFT Solution Design: Design scalable and secure SWIFT infrastructure solutions that support current and future business requirements Create technical designs for SWIFT message flows, system integrations, and connectivity patterns Review and validate SWIFT solution architectures to ensure alignment with MAS technology standards and security requirements Develop integration specifications for connecting SWIFT systems with core banking platforms and applications Evaluate SWIFT technology options and provide technical recommendations for system enhancements and upgrades Technical Implementation & Operations: Implement SWIFT message flows, routing configurations, and integration with core banking systems and applications based on approved designs. Configure and optimise SWIFT Alliance Access, Alliance Gateway, and related infrastructure components for maximum efficiency. Monitor SWIFT message traffic, system performance metrics, and availability statistics using platforms such as Zabbix and Elastic Search to proactively identify issues. Manage daily operational tasks including message queue monitoring, exception handling, and system health checks. Troubleshoot complex SWIFT connectivity issues, message processing errors, and performance bottlenecks to ensure minimal service disruption. Implement and maintain SWIFT Customer Security Programme (CSP) requirements and all mandatory security controls. Monitor SWIFT systems for security threats and maintain cybersecurity measures including network segregation, access controls, and threat detection systems. Conduct regular security assessments and vulnerability testing, coordinating with compliance teams on regulatory requirements and audit preparations. Maintain compliance with local banking regulations and international financial messaging standards, particularly for Critical Information Infrastructure (CII). Coordinate with SWIFT support teams, correspondent banks, technology vendors, and financial institution partners to resolve operational challenges and implement system enhancements. Execute SWIFT-related projects including system upgrades, new service implementations, and infrastructure improvements whilst managing stakeholder expectations and ensuring regulatory compliance. Create and maintain comprehensive documentation of SWIFT configurations, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides. Provide training programmes and knowledge transfer sessions to operations teams and stakeholders, ensuring knowledge management systems remain current and accessible. Identify and coordinate with business process owners and third-party SWIFT teams to oversee business process modelling. Support process automation by coordinating with third-party SWIFT teams to ensure processes are automated and adopted by business process owners. Act as the primary contact with MAS functional team and translate the requirements to the third-party analyst and developers when necessary to automate processes Provide SWIFT subject matter expertise to the Program testing team to ensure the test coverage is comprehensive Provide subject matter expertise as required should contentions arise on the technical requirements during the design phase between the third party and MAS and provide necessary arbitration to achieve a common goal Provide operational guidance on best practices for implementation plans. Procurement & Vendor Management: Lead procurement initiatives for SWIFT solutions, including preparation of comprehensive technical specifications, evaluation of vendor proposals, and contract negotiations Develop and execute procurement strategies that align with MAS's architectural vision and budgetary constraints, ensuring value for money and risk mitigation Establish and manage strategic vendor relationships with technology providers, ensuring alignment with architectural standards and business requirements Conduct comprehensive technical and commercial evaluations of SWIFT solutions, balancing cost-effectiveness with performance and security requirements Oversee vendor performance management and ensure compliance with contractual obligations and service level agreements Collaborate with MAS procurement and legal teams on contract approvals exceeding delegated authority
hrp|16704109|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-80c0-e51.requirements: Minimum of 5 years’ experience in the financial services, in particular in a technical business lead role with demonstrated experience in both hands-on SWIFT implementation and procurement management Extensive experience with banking operations, back-office business operations or back-office system integration knowledge Strong understanding of SWIFT-IBM MQ integration Strong technical background, with good understanding of SWIFT’s products, services and applications, including SWIFT PKI, SWIFT Alliance Gateway, SWIFT Alliance Access, SWIFT WebAccess, SWIFTNet, FIN/MX ISO20022 messaging formats Strong knowledge of payments and securities messaging and their flows is a must Good understanding of SWIFT’s Customer Security Program (CSP) and the proposed controls by SWIFT Experience in designing SWIFT technical solutions, integration patterns, and system connectivity architectures Strong understanding of API design, messaging patterns, and system integration methodologies Proven experience in vendor management and procurement processes, including technical specification development and contract negotiations Familiar with IT Infrastructure Technology Stack in a medium to large-scale implementation Familiar with Agile/Scrum Excellent written and verbal communication skills Must be organized, able to work with minimal supervision in a fast-paced working environment and adhere to organisational process and governance As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment. This is a 2-year contract position. All applicants will be notified on whether they are shortlisted or not within 4 weeks of the closing date of this job posting.
hrp|16704109|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-80c0-e51.description: MAS' IT Department seeks an experienced professional with expertise in SWIFT-related domain knowledge, including standards, payments and securities, combined with strong technical knowledge in payment systems and SWIFT solution design capabilities. In this role, you will provide comprehensive expertise in SWIFT-related business and technical workflows whilst overseeing SWIFT technical design. You will review SWIFT infrastructure architecture blueprints in collaboration with MAS internal cross-functional IT and operations teams to ensure architectural designs fulfil all requirements. You will also design and manage scalable SWIFT solutions that align with MAS's technology standards and integration requirements. As the designated Point-of-Contact for third-party SWIFT technical teams, you will review and guide SWIFT infrastructure implementation planning whilst coordinating with MAS internal teams to ensure resource availability.

hrp|16704109|005056a3-d347-1fe1-8ba7-e5f.responsibilities: SWIFT Solution Design: Design scalable and secure SWIFT infrastructure solutions that support current and future business requirements Create technical designs for SWIFT message flows, system integrations, and connectivity patterns Review and validate SWIFT solution architectures to ensure alignment with MAS technology standards and security requirements Develop integration specifications for connecting SWIFT systems with core banking platforms and applications Evaluate SWIFT technology options and provide technical recommendations for system enhancements and upgrades Technical Implementation & Operations: Implement SWIFT message flows, routing configurations, and integration with core banking systems and applications based on approved designs. Configure and optimise SWIFT Alliance Access, Alliance Gateway, and related infrastructure components for maximum efficiency. Monitor SWIFT message traffic, system performance metrics, and availability statistics using platforms such as Zabbix and Elastic Search to proactively identify issues. Manage daily operational tasks including message queue monitoring, exception handling, and system health checks. Troubleshoot complex SWIFT connectivity issues, message processing errors, and performance bottlenecks to ensure minimal service disruption. Implement and maintain SWIFT Customer Security Programme (CSP) requirements and all mandatory security controls. Monitor SWIFT systems for security threats and maintain cybersecurity measures including network segregation, access controls, and threat detection systems. Conduct regular security assessments and vulnerability testing, coordinating with compliance teams on regulatory requirements and audit preparations. Maintain compliance with local banking regulations and international financial messaging standards, particularly for Critical Information Infrastructure (CII). Coordinate with SWIFT support teams, correspondent banks, technology vendors, and financial institution partners to resolve operational challenges and implement system enhancements. Execute SWIFT-related projects including system upgrades, new service implementations, and infrastructure improvements whilst managing stakeholder expectations and ensuring regulatory compliance. Create and maintain comprehensive documentation of SWIFT configurations, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides. Provide training programmes and knowledge transfer sessions to operations teams and stakeholders, ensuring knowledge management systems remain current and accessible. Identify and coordinate with business process owners and third-party SWIFT teams to oversee business process modelling. Support process automation by coordinating with third-party SWIFT teams to ensure processes are automated and adopted by business process owners. Act as the primary contact with MAS functional team and translate the requirements to the third-party analyst and developers when necessary to automate processes Provide SWIFT subject matter expertise to the Program testing team to ensure the test coverage is comprehensive Provide subject matter expertise as required should contentions arise on the technical requirements during the design phase between the third party and MAS and provide necessary arbitration to achieve a common goal Provide operational guidance on best practices for implementation plans. Procurement & Vendor Management: Lead procurement initiatives for SWIFT solutions, including preparation of comprehensive technical specifications, evaluation of vendor proposals, and contract negotiations Develop and execute procurement strategies that align with MAS's architectural vision and budgetary constraints, ensuring value for money and risk mitigation Establish and manage strategic vendor relationships with technology providers, ensuring alignment with architectural standards and business requirements Conduct comprehensive technical and commercial evaluations of SWIFT solutions, balancing cost-effectiveness with performance and security requirements Oversee vendor performance management and ensure compliance with contractual obligations and service level agreements Collaborate with MAS procurement and legal teams on contract approvals exceeding delegated authority
hrp|16704109|005056a3-d347-1fe1-8ba7-e5f.requirements: Minimum of 5 years’ experience in the financial services, in particular in a technical business lead role with demonstrated experience in both hands-on SWIFT implementation and procurement management Extensive experience with banking operations, back-office business operations or back-office system integration knowledge Strong understanding of SWIFT-IBM MQ integration Strong technical background, with good understanding of SWIFT’s products, services and applications, including SWIFT PKI, SWIFT Alliance Gateway, SWIFT Alliance Access, SWIFT WebAccess, SWIFTNet, FIN/MX ISO20022 messaging formats Strong knowledge of payments and securities messaging and their flows is a must Good understanding of SWIFT’s Customer Security Program (CSP) and the proposed controls by SWIFT Experience in designing SWIFT technical solutions, integration patterns, and system connectivity architectures Strong understanding of API design, messaging patterns, and system integration methodologies Proven experience in vendor management and procurement processes, including technical specification development and contract negotiations Familiar with IT Infrastructure Technology Stack in a medium to large-scale implementation Familiar with Agile/Scrum Excellent written and verbal communication skills Must be organized, able to work with minimal supervision in a fast-paced working environment and adhere to organisational process and governance As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment. This is a 2-year contract position. All applicants will be notified on whether they are shortlisted or not within 4 weeks of the closing date of this job posting.
hrp|16704109|005056a3-d347-1fe1-8ba7-e5f.description: MAS' IT Department seeks an experienced professional with expertise in SWIFT-related domain knowledge, including standards, payments and securities, combined with strong technical knowledge in payment systems and SWIFT solution design capabilities. In this role, you will provide comprehensive expertise in SWIFT-related business and technical workflows whilst overseeing SWIFT technical design. You will review SWIFT infrastructure architecture blueprints in collaboration with MAS internal cross-functional IT and operations teams to ensure architectural designs fulfil all requirements. You will also design and manage scalable SWIFT solutions that align with MAS's technology standards and integration requirements. As the designated Point-of-Contact for third-party SWIFT technical teams, you will review and guide SWIFT infrastructure implementation planning whilst coordinating with MAS internal teams to ensure resource availability.

hrp|16733647|005056a3-53e2-1fd0-bdf9-fd7.responsibilities: As Manager, Bus Procurement , you will play a key role in shaping Singapore's next-generation public bus fleet. By 2030, we will be replacing half of our 6,000-strong bus fleet with cutting-edge electric vehicles, and this role puts you in the forefront of this historic transition. Working at the intersection of engineering, policy, and sustainability, you will lead strategic bus procurement initiatives that directly influence fleet performance, passenger experience, and long-term asset resilience. Your work will take you beyond Singapore's borders as you scout emerging technologies and collaborate with global manufacturers to bring the most advanced solutions to our streets. You'll witness firsthand the latest innovations in electric propulsion, autonomous systems, and smart connectivity as you help modernise a fleet that's not just safe and reliable, but also future-ready. As the Manager, Bus Procurement , you will drive diverse and impactful responsibilities encompassing comprehensive end-to-end bus procurement and strategic asset management, including: 1. Drive Fleet Renewal and Replacement : Lead the charge in developing and executing strategies to renew and replace fleet to meet operational, safety, and sustainability objectives across the public bus network. 2. Tender Specifications & Evaluation : Lead in drafting new buses requirements, preparing tender specifications, and evaluating submissions to ensure the best value for the fleet. 3. Quality Assurance : Conduct pre-delivery inspections and testing of bus equipment to ensure they comply with contract specifications and operational standards. 4. Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams : Coordinate with internal stakeholders (operations, engineering, policy, and system teams) to ensure seamless integration of bus systems and technologies onto the bus platform. 5. Partnership Management : Build and nurture strong relationships with overseas bus manufacturers and suppliers, staying informed on industry innovations and product developments. 6. Market Research & Design Specifications : Conduct in-depth research into emerging bus technologies and trends, making recommendations for design requirement to inform design improvements and future tender specifications. 7. Procurement Budget Oversight : Ensure cost-effective purchasing while maintaining high standards of quality, all within the boundaries of the procurement budget. Your work will directly support the advancement of Singapore's public bus fleet, enhance operational excellence and sustainability outcomes, and contribute to maintaining Singapore's position as a global leader in innovative and future-ready public transport solutions.
hrp|16733647|005056a3-53e2-1fd0-bdf9-fd7.requirements: We are seeking someone who has a passion for public transport and asset management. The ideal candidate will possess: Knowledge in Engineering (Electrical, Electrical & Electronic, Mechanical, Automotive or equivalent). Experience : At least 7 years of relevant experience in automotive, engineering, or related industries. Familiarity with battery systems, service, and maintenance of bus will be advantageous. Skills : Strong analytical, planning, and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, alongside proficiency in IT. Attributes : A proactive, self-motivated individual with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities effectively. As part of the shortlisting process for the role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and / or undergo further assessment.

Your work will take you beyond Singapore's borders as you scout emerging technologies and collaborate with global manufacturers to bring the most advanced solutions to our streets. You'll witness firsthand the latest innovations in electric propulsion, autonomous systems, and smart connectivity as you help modernise a fleet that's not just safe and reliable, but also future-ready. As the Manager, Bus Procurement , you will drive diverse and impactful responsibilities encompassing comprehensive end-to-end bus procurement and strategic asset management, including: 1. Drive Fleet Renewal and Replacement : Lead the charge in developing and executing strategies to renew and replace fleet to meet operational, safety, and sustainability objectives across the public bus network. 2. Tender Specifications & Evaluation : Lead in drafting new buses requirements, preparing tender specifications, and evaluating submissions to ensure the best value for the fleet. 3. Quality Assurance : Conduct pre-delivery inspections and testing of bus equipment to ensure they comply with contract specifications and operational standards. 4. Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams : Coordinate with internal stakeholders (operations, engineering, policy, and system teams) to ensure seamless integration of bus systems and technologies onto the bus platform. 5. Partnership Management : Build and nurture strong relationships with overseas bus manufacturers and suppliers, staying informed on industry innovations and product developments. 6. Market Research & Design Specifications : Conduct in-depth research into emerging bus technologies and trends, making recommendations for design requirement to inform design improvements and future tender specifications. 7. Procurement Budget Oversight : Ensure cost-effective purchasing while maintaining high standards of quality, all within the boundaries of the procurement budget. Your work will directly support the advancement of Singapore's public bus fleet, enhance operational excellence and sustainability outcomes, and contribute to maintaining Singapore's position as a global leader in innovative and future-ready public transport solutions.

hrp|16782304|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-a4a1-72c.responsibilities: Formulate policies, guidelines, and standard operating procedures (SOP) for the use of technologies and operations procedures to ensure operation sustainability. Review and prepare technical specifications for tender, contractual terms and requirement specifications for the procurement of contracts for good and services. You will ensure the maintenance of buildings and facilities, or its M&E system are in accordance with local building authorities’ standards, codes of practice and guidelines, such as BCA Green Mark requirements, Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act, as these buildings and facilities house critical equipment used for provision of Air Traffic Control (ATC) services. You will manage our maintenance contractors to ensure all maintenance services are performed to the highest performance standards, thus ensuring continued support for provision of ATC services. You will ensure the overall quality and integrity of the projects and A & A works. You will manage the project resources, finance and schedule by working with both internal and external parties to deliver buildings and facilities that meet the specified requirements. You will also support the renovation of existing or development of new offices and equipment rooms from project initiation to occupation by users /system owners.
hrp|16782304|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-a4a1-72c.requirements: Training in Civil Engineering, Project, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Facilities Management, Building or equivalent. Experience in civil maintenance works such as daily and periodic cleaning services, grass cutting, waste disposal, pest control, waterproofing works, structural inspection, minor building works, etc., and good experience in drafting and managing contracts, in particular, facilities management contracts. Experience in project management and facilities management, good knowledge of M&E system, good knowledge of BIM concepts and management processes including BIM project implementation for existing and new initiatives. Experience in Public Sector procurement procedures and regulatory requirements will be added advantage. Ability to respond on-site any time and support night works and/or duties Good team player who can work with officers of all levels Possess good communication and writing skills, interpersonal skills, positive altitude and an aptitude for details Have an inquisitive, open and analytical mind, and be self-driven
hrp|16782304|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-a4a1-72c.description: You will be responsible for project management, Addition & Alteration (A&A) works and supervision of maintenance of buildings and facilities or its M&E system. You will be required to propose, implement, and manage improvement initiatives to improve system and facility reliability, operational effectiveness, productivity, reduce cost and resources.

hrp|16825858|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-8da3-648.responsibilities: Plan and execute engagement activities, workshops, and events that promote life skills development and strengthen alumni involvement. Proficiency in data visualization and dashboard tools (e.g., Power BI) for evaluation and reporting. Analytical mindset with the ability to use data for continuous improvement and strategic decision-making. Creative and proactive approach to developing engagement strategies for students and alumni. #LI-Onsite
hrp|16825858|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-8da3-648.description: Support the Student Life and Alumni Relations (SLAR) by coordinating programs, events, and engagement activities that enhance student life skills development and foster alumni connections. hrp|16881996|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-8fd1-1e2.responsibilities: You will be part of the procurement team to: •Provide guidance to PA staff as an expert on procurement to ensure the applied methodologies would optimize the benefits of value-for-money for PA and GROs. •Assist in the review of PA procurement policies supported by data-driven analysis of procurement data to assess effectiveness of procurement governance. •Administer, review and enlarge commonly used goods and services for demand aggregation to meet business needs and enhance overall procurement performance. •Review procurement documents and ensure implementation of procurement templates and guidelines by PA staff to ensure compliance with existing requirements. •Engage stakeholders independently to provide advice on appropriate methods at pre-publication stage, and explore alternatives when situation is ambiguous or complex. •Oversee coordination of procurement trainings of PA staff to ensure they have up-to-date and clear understanding of procurement processes to perform their respective roles effectively. •Analyze gaps in procurement evaluation and identify developmental needs of PA staff to strengthen their procurement competency sustainably through e-learning. •Oversee management of WOG & PA procurement systems, guide and monitor Divisions on the proper use of systems for their procurement operations. •Design, build and enhance systems by leveraging on technology to digitalize and automate processes with more streamlined workflows to make procurement more efficient. hrp|16881996|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-8fd1-1e2.description: Strengthen governance and achieve value-for-money in procurement; and provide effective and efficient administration services in support of People’s Association’s objectives.

hrp|16881996|005056a3-d347-1fe1-808e-a15.responsibilities: You will be part of the procurement team to: •Provide guidance to PA staff as an expert on procurement to ensure the applied methodologies would optimize the benefits of value-for-money for PA and GROs. •Assist in the review of PA procurement policies supported by data-driven analysis of procurement data to assess effectiveness of procurement governance. •Administer, review and enlarge commonly used goods and services for demand aggregation to meet business needs and enhance overall procurement performance. •Review procurement documents and ensure implementation of procurement templates and guidelines by PA staff to ensure compliance with existing requirements. •Engage stakeholders independently to provide advice on appropriate methods at pre-publication stage, and explore alternatives when situation is ambiguous or complex. •Oversee coordination of procurement trainings of PA staff to ensure they have up-to-date and clear understanding of procurement processes to perform their respective roles effectively. •Analyze gaps in procurement evaluation and identify developmental needs of PA staff to strengthen their procurement competency sustainably through e-learning. •Oversee management of WOG & PA procurement systems, guide and monitor Divisions on the proper use of systems for their procurement operations. •Design, build and enhance systems by leveraging on technology to digitalize and automate processes with more streamlined workflows to make procurement more efficient. Other ad-hoc duties not covered under main responsibilities and duties. • Represent A&P in Working Committees as required. • Serves as PA procurement system Lead/Administrator. • Any other duties assigned under Administration and Procurement Division.
hrp|16881996|005056a3-d347-1fe1-808e-a15.requirements: Experience Minimum - At least three years of relevant working experience in procurement related roles such as procurement requestor, partner or analyst, etc. Desired – At least three years of procurement experience with good understanding on the Instruction Manual on Procurement and/or Grassroots Rules and Regulations. Others Possess good analytical, communication and writing skills, and able to work independently. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Successful candidates will be given a 3-year contract.
hrp|16881996|005056a3-d347-1fe1-808e-a15.description: Strengthen governance and achieve value-for-money in procurement; and provide effective and efficient administration services in support of People’s Association’s objectives.

Procurement & Admin • Assist the team with procurement of goods and services as necessary, including seeking necessary approvals and preparing relevant paperwork. • Assist the team with payments for goods and services received. • Assist Head of Department with calendar management. Other Roles • Annual Report Representative duties • Budget Coordination • Returns Coordination • Performance Management Support The role may comprise any other requests made by the reporting officer and Head of Department, but is not limited to the duties outlined above.
hrp|16898484|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-8ea1-216.requirements: What we are looking for • At least 1 year of relevant work experience in public policy, business, economics, social sciences or related fields. • Entry level applicants are welcomed if they demonstrate key competencies in areas highlighted in the job description. • Skills and competencies preferably in business, economics, communications or related fields. • Inquisitive mind, strong analytical and critical thinking skills • Adept at working with numbers and good knowledge of Excel, as well as Word and Powerpoint. Familiarity with data analysis and visualisation tools (e.g. Tableau) preferred. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, to deliver presentations and facilitate meetings • Team player who is proactive, independent and reliable to drive projects forward • Strong relationship management skills • Experience in managing or running events (of any scale) will be an advantage Functional Competencies required by this role • Internal Stakeholder Alignment • Deep Critical Thinking • Clear and Concise Writing • Corporate Performance Management • Strategic Planning
hrp|16898484|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-8ea1-216.description: What the role is: You will be providing support to the Policy & Planning department at NAC. In this role, you will assist with the various administrative and coordination functions that enable the smooth operation of the department’s core workstreams. Your work will span across secretariat duties, performance management support, and departmental coordination activities. You will serve as a key support resource helping to ensure continuity and efficiency in the department’s operations. You will be required to work closely with team members at various levels and assist with both routine administrative tasks and more complex coordination activities as needed. This role offers an opportunity to support NAC's strategic planning and policy development work for Singapore's arts sector.

hrp|16906462|005056a3-53e2-1fd0-bf90-df1.responsibilities: You will also be working on environmental and sustainability issues relating to the management of Singapore’s currency in circulation. You will have opportunities to be involved in the following areas of work: Managing replenishment of circulation currency (notes and coins), including administering procurement procedures and liaising with appointed currency printers and relevant stakeholders, to ensure availability of currency stock to meet public demand and fulfilment of contractual requirements Supervising and managing appointed contractors for outsourced currency operations (i.e. issuing, receiving, processing and storage of notes and coins), through conducting onsite inspections, reviewing reports and performance evaluations, to ensure deliverables and contractual requirements are met Managing numismatic and commemorative currency projects, including conducting research and working with designers, to ensure smooth implementation in the issuance of such notes and coins Conducting currency research to keep abreast of the latest developments and advancements in the industry Handling currency-related enquiries and feedback from members of the public and the media You will be working in a fast-paced environment that would require the ability to manage multiple priorities and needs of different stakeholders, as well as the agility to respond to changes and developments in the industry.
hrp|16906462|005056a3-53e2-1fd0-bf90-df1.requirements: Applicants must be Singapore citizens Possess good inter-personal and communication skills Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills Able to work well in both team and individual settings Working experience in project/contract management Good knowledge of government procurement principles and processes As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment. All applicants will be notified on whether they are shortlisted or not within 4 weeks of the closing date of this job posting.
hrp|16906462|005056a3-53e2-1fd0-bf90-df1.description: You will be part of the Coins & Business Excellence Division in the Currency Department responsible for managing the procurement of circulation currency stock, outsourced currency operations and development of new currency projects.

hrp|16913554|005056a3-53e2-1fd0-bfaa-08a.responsibilities: In this role, you will provide comprehensive expertise in SWIFT-related business and technical workflows whilst overseeing SWIFT technical design. You will review SWIFT infrastructure architecture blueprints in collaboration with MAS internal cross-functional IT and operations teams to ensure architectural designs fulfil all requirements. You will also design and manage scalable SWIFT solutions that align with MAS's technology standards and integration requirements. As the designated Point-of-Contact for SWIFT technical teams, you will review and guide SWIFT Alliance implementation planning whilst coordinating with MAS internal teams to ensure resource availability. As part of the team, you will handle: SWIFT Solution Design: Evaluate SWIFT technology options review and validate SWIFT product architectures to ensure alignment with MAS technology standards and security requirements product that support current and future business requirements Create technical designs for SWIFT message flows, system integrations, and connectivity patterns between SWIFT Product with MEPS+ and MAS back-office platforms and applications Technical Implementation & Operations: Identify and coordinate with business process owners and third-party SWIFT teams to oversee business process modelling. Implement, configure, upgrade, enhance and optimise SWIFT Alliance Product, and related infrastructure components for maximum efficiency (e.g. routing rules, access control). Provide subject matter expertise as required should contentions arise on the technical requirements during the design phase between the third party and MAS and provide necessary arbitration to achieve a common goal Manage daily operational tasks including exception handling, and system health checks (e.g monitoring message flow, system performance metrics, vulnerability management) Troubleshoot complex SWIFT connectivity issues, message processing errors, and performance bottlenecks to ensure minimal service disruption. Implement and maintain SWIFT Customer Security Programme (CSP) requirements and all mandatory security controls. Procurement & Vendor Management: Lead procurement initiatives for SWIFT solutions, including preparation of comprehensive technical specifications, and evaluation of vendor proposals Oversee vendor performance management and ensure compliance with contractual obligations and service level agreements
hrp|16913554|005056a3-53e2-1fd0-bfaa-08a.requirements: Experience and Technical skill set required: Good Degree with at least 5 years' relevant experience in financial services, with demonstrated experience in both hands-on SWIFT implementation . Extensive experience with back-office business operations or back-office system integration knowledge Strong understanding of SWIFT-IBM MQ integration Strong technical background, with good understanding of SWIFT’s products, services and applications, including SWIFT PKI, SWIFT Alliance Gateway, SWIFT Alliance Access, SWIFT WebAccess, SWIFTNet, FIN/MX ISO20022 messaging formats Good understanding of SWIFT’s Customer Security Program (CSP) and the proposed controls by SWIFT Experience in designing SWIFT technical solutions, integration patterns, and system connectivity architectures Strong understanding of API design, messaging patterns, and system integration methodologies Familiar with IT Infrastructure Technology Stack in a medium to large-scale implementation Experience and Technical Skillset which would be an advantage: Understanding of financial instruments, payment and security settlement flow Proven experience in vendor management and procurement processes, including technical specification development Proven experience in process re-engineering and automation Soft Skills: Able to work independently as well as in a team Ability to work with details and time-sensitive issues. Strong interpersonal communication and organizing skills to coordinate and faciliate project activities and discussions. Ability to work with minimal supervision and adapt to a rapidly changing environment. This is a 2-Year contract position. As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment. All applicants will be notified on whether they are shortlisted or not within 4 weeks of the closing date of this job posting.

hrp|16913555|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-a4ba-924.responsibilities: Operational Delivery & Application Portfolio Management Own operational delivery outcomes for the MEPS+ application portfolio across interbank payments, government securities management, and domestic market infrastructures. Make and recommend strategic decisions on application rationalisation, consolidation, or decommissioning to optimise portfolio efficiency. Coordinate release management and delivery cycles with product owners, ensuring timely and quality deployment of enhancements, patches, and security updates across major (semi-annual) and monthly patch cycles. Own Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for applications under management. Review SLI and SLO performance reports produced by the SRE team, identify trends and deviations, and escalate or drive remediation as appropriate. Set requirements for monitoring coverage and alert quality; hold the SRE team accountable for outcomes. Coordinate verification of monthly and quarterly system patching with the SRE team. Ensure patch outcomes are documented and meet compliance requirements. Tech Delivery Manager Responsibilities (During Release Cycles) Lead release planning and delivery activities during major enhancement releases (semi-annual). Coordinate with product owners, development teams, testing teams, and vendors to establish release scope, timelines, and deployment readiness criteria. Manage release communication to all stakeholders. Provide status updates, escalate blockers, and maintain stakeholder alignment on release objectives and timelines throughout the cycle. Own release governance and quality standards for MEPS+. Define the release readiness criteria and test governance framework that the Software Engineer executes against. Review and sign off on test outcomes, patch verification results, and release readiness reports before production deployment. Incident Management Own the incident management framework for MEPS+. Define and maintain incident escalation paths, SLO targets (P1, P2, P3), and communication protocols. During major incidents, lead stakeholder communication and coordinate the response — software engineers provide technical investigation and resolution support. Drive root cause analysis and post-mortems following significant incidents. Own the documentation of lessons learned and track implementation of preventive measures to reduce recurrence. Vendor Coordination & Procurement Own vendor governance for outsourced components and services. Chair vendor performance reviews, monitor SLA compliance, and make escalation decisions when vendor performance falls short. Coordinate with software engineers for detailed technical review of vendor-delivered code and fixes. Lead MAS's participation in procurement activities for outsourced services, including defining tender specifications, evaluating vendor proposals, and contributing to contract negotiations. Compliance, Governance & Risk Management Coordinate RFI responses across the team, ensuring accurate and timely submission of supporting documentation. Plan and lead resiliency exercises including Disaster Recovery drills, manual contingency procedures, and CyberEx participation. Validate system failover and recovery capabilities. Maintain compliance with ICT Governance policies and standards specific to government financial infrastructure.
hrp|16913555|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-a4ba-924.requirements: Essential Criteria 8+ years of progressive experience in managing, operating, or delivering complex mission-critical systems. Minimum 3–4 years in a delivery management, operations management, or technical programme management role with clear accountability for system reliability or release outcomes. Experience with payment systems, securities settlement, or financial infrastructure is advantageous but not required. Demonstrated ability to lead incident response at an organisational level — owning stakeholder communication, driving post-mortems, and implementing systemic improvements. Track record of managing high-stakes operational environments. Proven experience managing vendor relationships, chairing performance reviews, and holding vendors accountable to SLAs. Experience contributing to procurement or contract management activities. Strong experience coordinating release cycles across multiple teams — development, testing, operations, and compliance — with accountability for release readiness decisions. Excellent communication skills. Able to explain technical risks, operational decisions, and compliance requirements clearly to senior leadership, business stakeholders, and regulators. Strong written communication for incident reports, post-mortems, audit RFI responses, and governance documentation. Comfortable working across technical domains without requiring deep hands-on expertise in every platform. Able to engage credibly with software engineers and SRE colleagues, ask the right questions, and make informed decisions based on their input. Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams — incident response, release coordination, compliance activities, vendor management — without losing attention to detail or governance rigour. Desirable Criteria Familiarity with Java/J2EE application environments, Linux/RHEL systems, or SQL — sufficient to engage meaningfully with engineering teams and understand technical risk, without necessarily being a hands-on practitioner. Experience with containerisation technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) or cloud platforms (OpenShift, OpenStack) at a conceptual or governance level. Experience with CICD pipelines, release automation, and test management frameworks. Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms (e.g. Grafana, ELK stack) from an operational governance perspective. Familiarity with government IT environments and regulatory compliance frameworks (CCoP, CSP, AGO, IM8). Agile delivery experience and comfort collaborating with product teams and development teams. Relevant certifications (e.g. ITIL, PMP, AWS Solutions Architect, or equivalent).
hrp|16913555|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-a4ba-924.description: The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) is Singapore's central bank and integrated financial regulator. MEPS+ (Central Banking & Devt Platforms Division) is responsible for the MAS Electronic Payment System — a mission-critical system supporting interbank payments, government securities management, and domestic market infrastructure. MEPS+ serves the entire Singapore financial sector and requires 24/7 operational reliability, strict compliance with government regulatory frameworks, and close coordination with financial institutions and government agencies. As System Manager, you are the operational and delivery owner for MEPS+ and related systems. You own the outcomes, and coordinate across software engineers, product owners, compliance teams, and external vendors to ensure system reliability, regulatory compliance, and successful delivery of enhancements and patches.

hrp|16953751|005056a3-53e2-1fd0-bfb6-19a.responsibilities: 1. ICT Project Management • Lead end to end project planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery of ICT and digitalisation initiatives. • Develop project and programme strategies that align with GRA’s Digitalisation Plan and organisation mission. • Establish and maintain appropriate project governance structure, including steering / working committees and decision-making mechanisms / processes to ensure timely delivery. • Drive the adoption of project management methodologies, tools and framework to enhance delivery outcome • Manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and change requests with timely and proper documentation and escalation. • Track and analyse project performance, prepare progress reports, and ensure alignment with GRA’s strategic programmes. 2. ICT Governance & Compliance • Ensure all ICT projects comply to WOG / GRA’s ICT governance frameworks and policies, IT security standards, data privacy / protection and risk management requirements. • Partner with the ICT governance team to incorporate required controls into project design, implementation, and operations. • Lead audit exercises, internal/external reviews and quality assurance checks for compliance with data privacy / protection, security, procurement and IM policies. 3. Support GRA’s Digitalisation Strategy • Contribute to the development, implementation and continuous improvement of GRA’s digitalisation strategy and roadmap. • Identify opportunities for process optimisation, automation, and adoption of innovative technologies to enhance organisation efficiency. • Support performance monitoring and reporting of digitalisation KPIs and project outcome. • Surface gaps, risk and improvement areas to strengthen digital capability and technology governance. 4. Stakeholder & Vendor Management • Serve as the primary liaison with business users and management to ensure alignment and buy-in for digital initiatives. • Gather and translate user requirements into clear project scopes and deliverables. • Manage vendor relationships, including procurement activities, contract administration and performance evaluation. • Facilitate workshops, briefings, and communication sessions to ensure stakeholders alignment and readiness for deployment of new system. • Drive change management efforts to support smooth adoption of new systems, processes and technologies.
hrp|16953751|005056a3-53e2-1fd0-bfb6-19a.requirements: • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline. • Minimum 3 – 5 years of relevant experience in ICT project management or IT consulting, preferably in digitalisation projects. • Strong understanding of ICT governance, risk management, security and data privacy / protection best practices. • Demonstrated experience in managing multiple projects and stakeholders in a fast paced environment. • Analytical, proactive and able to navigate challenges with creatively and sound judgement. • Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels • Experience with government ICT projects or ISO9001 aligned project management practices is an advantage. • Professional certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, CITPM, Scrum Master, COMIT will be an advantage.
hrp|16953751|005056a3-53e2-1fd0-bfb6-19a.description: The Project Manager (ICT Projects) is responsible for planning, leading, and delivering ICT and digitalisation initiatives that support GRA’s strategic objectives. The role ensures that projects comply with WOG/GRA ICT governance frameworks, security and data privacy / protection requirements, and established project management standards. The Project Manager will work closely with internal stakeholders and external partners to drive project success from initiation to implementation, including risk, change management and benefits realisation.

hrp|16958350|005056a3-d347-1fe1-81dd-381.responsibilities: Responsibilities: • Be a member in the OM team for the day-to-day operations and management of office building, facilities, security, projects and office space planning in AGC. • Oversees and manage the Integrated Facilities Management (IFM) vendor and administration of the contract to ensure maintenance of the office premises is efficiently managed and in accordance to contract requirements. • Ensures vendors meet the contractual obligations and goods/ services are delivered in accordance with the service agreements. • Manages current processes and systems and to develop and execute improvement plans to enhance operations and internal stakeholder satisfaction and engagement. • Oversees the management of office equipment and furniture, maintenance of Mechanical and Electrical services/ systems, Fire protection system, VOIP systems, AVVC system and facilities operations with the in-house IFM, including service requests, and fault reporting. • Oversees the testing and maintenance of the Fire Alarm System, Fire Protection System and PA System, including comms to affected officers. • Management of public utilities and telecommunications usage including verifying and monitoring payment. • Oversees the management/ stock take of AGC fixed assets and inventories and Records Management filing in accordance with relevant guidelines. • Prepares AOR papers, ITQ/ ITT specifications, calling, evaluating and award of tenders for contracts and putting up approval papers for the procurement of items/ contracts under the portfolio. • Provides support in other portfolio such as projects management, events/logistics management, workplace safety and health, emergency preparedness and inventory stock management (where required). • Performs any other duties assigned by the Operations Department.
hrp|16958350|005056a3-d347-1fe1-81dd-381.requirements: Requirements: • Qualifications in Building, Projects & Facilities Management, Mechanical & Electrical Engineering, or equivalent. • Minimum 3 years of relevant working experience in managing IFM/ MEP system/ project management or equivalent. • Familiar in government procurement and financial Instruction Manuals is preferred. • Possess good writing and communication skills. • Familiar with the use of Microsoft Office applications. • Positive mindset, meticulous, result-oriented and analytical. • Strong team player and ability to work independently. Our Commitment to You The AGC offers a salary commensurate with your experience and qualifications, Annual Variable bonuses, performance bonuses and annual increments based on merit. We invest in our officers and support their career aspirations so that they can reach their fullest potential. We also place great importance on our officers’ physical and mental well-being through work-life harmony programmes. Successful candidates will be appointed on a contract basis in the first instance. Should you encounter difficulty in applying for this role, please email us directly at AGC_HR_Recruit@agc.gov.sg before the closing date of this job posting. Kindly attach your resume and indicate this position you are keen on in the email subject.

hrp|16962304|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-85e7-cd1.responsibilities: Provide subject matter consultancy and expertise in the provision of ICT systems, solutions and services for a Digital Workplace. Propose technical designs, solutions and integrations that work well with the Government infrastructure and are compliant with policies, standards and security requirements. Lead projects and manage vendors in the implementation and support of Digital Workplace systems and end-user computing technologies according to business and security requirements. Evaluate and conduct proof-of-concepts with Product Principals and System Integrators on Digital Transformation/Digital Workplace technologies and related security solutions. Seek and analyse root causes of issues by deep understanding of the enterprise environment and collaborating with technical teams from various domains and vendors in providing solutions. Manage procurement and maintenance renewals of hardware, software and ICT service subscriptions including preparation of technical specifications. Analyse, develop and communicate the technology deployment process, seek feedback from stakeholders and make continual improvement in the operations phase. Conduct user briefing sessions/training to prepare users in adopting new solutions with the creation of impactful communications and documentations.

hrp|16981248|005056a3-53e2-1fd0-bbf1-34b.description: Procurement Professional Programme (P3) Job Application Period: 12 Jan – 15 Mar 2026 Are you ready to make an impact on Singapore’s public services and economy? Join the two-year Procurement Professional Programme and help transform government procurement. As part of a function managing $28 billion in annual government spending, you will support public service delivery, contribute to economic sustainability, and ensure prudent use of public funds. This is a 2-year full-time role with rotations across public service agencies, certified training, exposure to government procurement policy and operational procurement work, community learning, and mentoring. The role requires a Whole-of-Government (WOG) mindset, critical thinking, commercial acumen, stakeholder management, business partnership skills, and understanding of governance principles. You will join the Ministry of Finance – Government Procurement Function Office (GPFO), established in 2020 to lead and transform WOG procurement. By the end of the programme, you will be equipped with core procurement competencies and diverse experiences, ready to drive government procurement transformation and impact national growth.

hrp|16991248|005056a3-53e2-1fd1-83c0-386.responsibilities: This incumbent will support ActiveSG’s risk management and compliance effort by actively managing compliance functions, proactively addressing emerging challenges and advising and recommending effective internal controls and best practices while reviewing processes holistically. This would involve establishing robust controls, enhancing compliance capabilities, and ensuring adherence to applicable guidelines, regulations and industry standards. Role and Responsibilities: • To establish, maintain and update compliance-related policies and procedures • To develop, review and refine existing and new operating procedures, frameworks and systems to carry out compliance functions • To engage with stakeholders through dialogues and consultations to garner feedback, understand their challenges and explore solutions on relevant issues relating to compliance matters. • To keep abreast of evolving regulatory landscapes, industry trends, and emerging compliance issues, proactively assess their impact on operations and recommend appropriate strategies to ensure ongoing compliance. • To manage the execution of risk strategies and risk mitigation plan • To identify, assess, and document compliance risks associated with business activities and operations, conducting quarterly compliance risk assessments • To undertake monitoring and compliance-related work to ensure that employees maintain professional standards of conduct, and comply with the relevant guidelines • To investigate complaints or findings made in respect of alleged professional misconduct / non-compliance with policies and procedures. • To develop compliance action plans to mitigate identified risks based on the outcomes of compliance risk assessments. • To coordinate and support internal and external compliance audits and examinations. Collaborate with audit teams to address any findings and implement corrective actions. Ensure proper documentation, resolution, and reporting of investigation outcomes. • To collaborate with professional bodies and training providers to develop continuing professional education or training programmes to enhance awareness and understanding of compliance obligations across the organization. • To ensure employees are well-informed about their responsibilities regarding applicable guidelines, regulations, and industry standards. • To develop and monitor a training assessment and feedback system.
